translations.literal: Wang Huaji, Lü Youzhi, and Yue Shi recommended him to the court; he was promoted to Editorial Assistant, and after only one month, when evaluations were held, he was further transferred to Palace Aide, sent out to govern Pengzhou, and concurrently appointed Investigating Censor.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Huaji, Lü Youzhi, and Yue Shi recommended him at court. He was promoted to Editorial Assistant, and after only one month, when evaluations were held, he was further made Palace Aide, sent out to govern Pengzhou, and concurrently appointed Investigating Censor.

sentences.zh: 轉運使劉錫、馬襄上其治跡，召歸。

translations.literal: Transport commissioners Liu Xi and Ma Xiang submitted reports on his governance; he was recalled.
translations.idiomatic: Transport commissioners Liu Xi and Ma Xiang submitted reports on his record of governance, and he was recalled to court.

sentences.zh: 會浦洛之敗，奉詔劾白守榮輩，獄成，太宗獎其勤，面賜緋魚。

translations.literal: When the defeat at Puluo occurred, he was ordered to investigate Bai Shourong and others; the case completed, Taizong praised his diligence and personally granted him scarlet robes and fish insignia.
translations.idiomatic: When the defeat at Puluo occurred, he was ordered to investigate Bai Shourong and his associates. After the case was completed, Taizong praised his diligence and personally granted him scarlet robes and fish insignia.

sentences.zh: 川陝豪民多旁戶，以小民役屬者為佃客，使之如奴隸，家或數十戶，凡租調庸斂，悉佃客承之。

translations.literal: In Sichuan and Shaanxi, great families often had secondary households; they made subordinate commoners work as tenant clients, treating them like slaves, with households sometimes numbering several tens; all rent, tax, and corvée levies were entirely borne by the tenant clients.
translations.idiomatic: In Sichuan and Shaanxi, powerful families often maintained secondary households. They made subordinate commoners serve as tenant clients and treated them like slaves; some households numbered several dozen families, and all rent, tax, and corvée levies were borne entirely by the tenant clients.

sentences.zh: 時有言李順之亂，皆旁戶鳩集，請擇旁戶為三耆長迭主之，疇歲勞則授以官，詔師道使兩川議其事。

translations.literal: At the time it was said that Li Shun's rebellion had gathered many secondary households together; a proposal was made to select secondary households as three elder chiefs who would rotate in leadership, and after laboring for a year they would be granted office; an edict ordered Shidao to go to the Two River valleys to discuss the matter.
translations.idiomatic: At the time it was said that Li Shun's rebellion had drawn many secondary households together. Some proposed selecting secondary households as three elder chiefs to rotate in leadership, with office granted after a year's labor. An edict ordered Shidao to go to the Two River valleys to discuss the plan.

sentences.zh: 師道以為迭使主領則爭忿滋多，署以名級又重增擾害，廷奏非便，卒罷之。

translations.literal: Shidao held that rotating leadership would increase quarrels and resentment, and appointing them with titles and ranks would further aggravate harm; he memorialized at court that it was inconvenient, and it was ultimately abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Shidao argued that rotating leadership would only increase quarrels and resentment, and granting them titles and ranks would further aggravate the harm. He memorialized at court that the plan was impractical, and it was ultimately abandoned.

sentences.zh: 改祠部員外郎，出為京東轉運使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Deputy Director of the Sacrifices Bureau and sent out as transport commissioner of the Jingdong circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Deputy Director of the Sacrifices Bureau and sent out as transport commissioner of the Jingdong circuit.

sentences.zh: 真宗嗣位，進秩度支。

translations.literal: When Zhenzong succeeded the throne, he was promoted in rank in the Bureau of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhenzong succeeded to the throne, Shidao was promoted in rank within the Bureau of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 咸平初，范正辭薦其材堪長民，徙知潤州。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xianping, Fan Zhengci recommended his talent as fit to govern the people; he was transferred to govern Runzhou.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Xianping era, Fan Zhengci recommended his talent as fit to govern the people, and he was transferred to serve as prefect of Runzhou.

sentences.zh: 三年，改淮南轉運副使兼淮南、江、浙、荊湖發運使。

translations.literal: In the third year, he was made Deputy Transport Commissioner of Huainan and concurrently Grain Transport Commissioner for Huainan, Jiang, Zhe, and Jinghu.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was made Deputy Transport Commissioner of Huainan and concurrently Grain Transport Commissioner for Huainan, Jiang, Zhe, and Jinghu.

sentences.zh: 四年，以漕事入奏，特遷司封，俄為正使，改工部郎中，代查道為三司度支副使。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, he entered court to report on grain transport affairs and was specially promoted to Director of the Seals Bureau; soon he became chief commissioner, transferred to Director of the Works Bureau, and replaced Cha Dao as Deputy Commissioner of Revenue of the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he entered court to report on grain transport affairs and was specially promoted to Director of the Seals Bureau. Soon he became chief commissioner, was transferred to Director of the Works Bureau, and replaced Cha Dao as Deputy Commissioner of Revenue of the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 七月，擢樞密直學士，掌三班。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, he was promoted to Privy Council Academician and managed the Three Classes.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he was promoted to Privy Council Academician and placed in charge of the Three Classes.

sentences.zh: 俄擢權三司使，從幸澶淵，判隨駕三司，充都轉運使。

translations.literal: Soon he was promoted to Acting Commissioner of the Three Departments; he accompanied the emperor to Chanyuan, judged the imperial retinue Three Departments, and served as Chief Transport Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was promoted to Acting Commissioner of the Three Departments. He accompanied the emperor to Chanyuan, judged the imperial retinue Three Departments, and served as Chief Transport Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 師道弟幾道，舉進士禮部奏名，將廷試，近製悉糊名較等，陳堯谘當為考官，教幾道於卷中密為識號。

translations.literal: Shidao's younger brother Jidao passed the Ministry of Rites preliminary jinshi examination and was about to take the palace examination; by recent regulation all papers were sealed for anonymous grading; Chen Yaozi was to be an examiner and taught Jidao to place secret marks on his paper.
translations.idiomatic: Shidao's younger brother Jidao passed the Ministry of Rites preliminary jinshi examination and was about to take the palace examination. By recent regulation all papers were sealed for anonymous grading. Chen Yaozi was to serve as an examiner and taught Jidao to place secret marks on his examination paper.

sentences.zh: 幾道既擢第，事泄，詔落其籍，永不預舉。

translations.literal: After Jidao was placed on the list, the affair leaked; an edict struck him from the rolls and permanently barred him from examinations.
translations.idiomatic: After Jidao was placed on the list, the affair came to light. An edict struck him from the rolls and permanently barred him from the examinations.

sentences.zh: 師道固求辨理，詔曹利用、邊肅、閻承翰詣御史府推治之。

translations.literal: Shidao repeatedly begged to clear the matter; an edict ordered Cao Yiliang, Bian Su, and Yan Chenghan to go to the Censorate to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Shidao repeatedly petitioned to have the matter cleared. An edict ordered Cao Yiliang, Bian Su, and Yan Chenghan to go to the Censorate to investigate.

sentences.zh: 坐論奏誣罔，責為忠武軍行軍司馬，堯谘免所居官，為鄆州團練副使。

translations.literal: Convicted of memorializing falsely, he was demoted to Army Adjutant of Zhongwu; Yaozi was removed from his post and made Deputy Militia Commissioner of Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Convicted of memorializing falsely, Shidao was demoted to Army Adjutant of Zhongwu. Yaozi was removed from his post and made Deputy Militia Commissioner of Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 二年，以郊祀恩，起為工部郎中、知復州，換秀州。

translations.literal: In the second year, through the grace of the suburban sacrifice, he was restored as Director of the Works Bureau and governed Fuzhou, then transferred to Xiuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, through the grace of the suburban sacrifice, he was restored as Director of the Works Bureau and appointed prefect of Fuzhou, then transferred to Xiuzhou.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符二年，以兵部郎中知潭州，遷太常少卿。

translations.literal: In the second year of Dazhong Xiangfu, as Director of the War Bureau he governed Tanzhou and was transferred to Vice Director of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Dazhong Xiangfu he served as Director of the War Bureau and prefect of Tanzhou, then was transferred to Vice Director of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 師道敏於吏事，所至有聲，吏民畏愛。

translations.literal: Shidao was quick in administrative affairs; wherever he went he gained renown, and officials and people both feared and loved him.
translations.idiomatic: Shidao was quick in administrative affairs. Wherever he went he gained renown, and officials and commoners both feared and loved him.

sentences.zh: 長沙當湖、嶺都會，剖煩析滯，案無留事。

translations.literal: Changsha lay at the convergence of lake and mountain routes; he cut through vexations and resolved backlog, and no cases were left pending.
translations.idiomatic: Changsha stood at the convergence of lake and mountain routes. He cut through vexations and cleared backlog, and no cases were left pending.

sentences.zh: 歲滿，復加樞密直學士，換左司郎中，留一任。

translations.literal: When his term expired, he was again made Privy Council Academician, transferred to Left Department Director, and kept for one more term.
translations.idiomatic: When his term expired, he was again made Privy Council Academician, transferred to Left Department Director, and retained for one more term.

sentences.zh: 七年，李應機代還。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Li Yingji was sent to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Li Yingji was sent to replace him.

sentences.zh: 應機未至郡，六月，師道暴病卒，年五十四，錄幾道為試秘書省校書郎。

translations.literal: Before Yingji reached the prefecture, in the sixth month Shidao suddenly fell ill and died at fifty-four; Jidao was enrolled as probationary proofreader of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Before Yingji reached the prefecture, in the sixth month Shidao suddenly fell ill and died at the age of fifty-four. Jidao was enrolled as probationary proofreader of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 師道性慷慨尚氣，善談世務，與人交敦篤。

translations.literal: Shidao was by nature generous and spirited, skilled at discussing current affairs, and devoted in his dealings with others.
translations.idiomatic: By nature Shidao was generous and spirited. He was skilled at discussing current affairs and devoted in his dealings with others.

sentences.zh: 工為詩，多與楊億輩酬唱，當時稱之。

translations.literal: He was skilled at poetry and often exchanged verses with Yang Yi and others; he was praised at the time.
translations.idiomatic: He was skilled at poetry and often exchanged verses with Yang Yi and others, and was praised at the time.

sentences.zh: 王濟，字巨川。

translations.literal: Wang Ji, styled Juchuan.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ji, styled Juchuan.

sentences.zh: 其先真定人，祖卿，有詞辨，趙王熔召置幕府。

translations.literal: His ancestors were from Zhending; his grandfather Qing was eloquent in debate and was summoned by Prince Zhao Rong to serve on his staff.
translations.idiomatic: His ancestors were from Zhending. His grandfather Qing was eloquent in debate and was summoned by Prince Zhao Rong to serve on his staff.

sentences.zh: 熔政衰，卿懼禍，避地深州饒陽，遂為縣人。

translations.literal: When Rong's rule declined, Qing feared disaster, fled to Raoyang in Shenzhou, and became a man of that county.
translations.idiomatic: When Rong's rule declined, Qing feared disaster, fled to Raoyang in Shenzhou, and became a man of that county.

sentences.zh: 父恕，後唐時童子及第，開寶中，知秀州。

translations.literal: His father Shu passed the child examination in Later Tang; in the Kaibao era he governed Xiuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: His father Shu passed the child examination in Later Tang and, in the Kaibao era, served as prefect of Xiuzhou.

sentences.zh: 會盜起，城陷，為盜所殺，將並害濟。

translations.literal: When bandits rose, the city fell; he was killed by bandits, who were about to kill Ji as well.
translations.idiomatic: When bandits rose, the city fell. Shu was killed by the bandits, who were about to kill Ji as well.

sentences.zh: 濟伏柩號慟，謂賊曰：「吾父已死，吾安用生為，但恨力不能殺汝，以報父仇爾！

translations.literal: Ji prostrated himself before the coffin and wailed, saying to the bandits: "My father is already dead—what use is my life? I only regret I lack the strength to kill you and avenge my father!"
translations.idiomatic: Ji prostrated himself before the coffin and wailed, saying to the bandits, "My father is already dead—what use is my life? I only regret that I lack the strength to kill you and avenge my father!"

sentences.zh: 」賊義之，舍去。

translations.literal: The bandits admired his righteousness and let him go.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits admired his righteousness and let him go.

sentences.zh: 濟攜父骨匿山谷間。

translations.literal: Ji carried his father's bones and hid in the mountains and valleys.
translations.idiomatic: Ji carried his father's bones and hid among the mountains and valleys.

sentences.zh: 既而官軍大集，濟脫身謁其帥朱乙，陳討賊之計。

translations.literal: Before long the government troops gathered in force; Ji made his way out to visit their commander Zhu Yi and laid out a plan to suppress the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the government troops gathered in force. Ji made his way out to visit their commander Zhu Yi and laid out a plan to suppress the bandits.

sentences.zh: 乙嘉之，遺以束帛，奏假驛置遣歸。

translations.literal: Yi praised him, presented him with silk, and memorialized for courier relays to send him home.
translations.idiomatic: Yi praised him, presented him with silk, and memorialized for courier relays to send him home.

sentences.zh: 先是，濟母終於嶽陽，權窆佛舍。

translations.literal: Earlier, Ji's mother had died at Yueyang and was temporarily buried at a Buddhist temple.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Ji's mother had died at Yueyang and was temporarily buried at a Buddhist temple.

sentences.zh: 至是，乃並護二喪還饒陽。

translations.literal: At this time he escorted both coffins back to Raoyang.
translations.idiomatic: At this time he escorted both coffins back to Raoyang.

sentences.zh: 州將以聞，太祖召見，以其尚少，且俾就學。

translations.literal: The prefectural commander reported it; Taizu summoned him for an audience, and because he was still young, ordered him to continue his studies.
translations.idiomatic: The prefectural commander reported the matter. Taizu summoned him for an audience and, because he was still young, ordered him to continue his studies.

sentences.zh: 雍熙中，上書自陳死事之孤，得試學士院，補龍溪主簿。

translations.literal: In the Yongxi era he submitted a memorial declaring himself an orphan of one who died in office; he was allowed to take the Hanlin examination and was appointed registrar of Longxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yongxi era he submitted a memorial declaring himself an orphan of one who died in office. He was allowed to take the Hanlin examination and was appointed registrar of Longxi.

sentences.zh: 時調福建輸鶴翎為箭羽。

translations.literal: At the time Fujian was levied to supply crane feathers for arrow fletching.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Fujian was levied to supply crane feathers for arrow fletching.

sentences.zh: 鶴非常有物，有司督責急，一羽至直數百錢，民甚苦之。

translations.literal: Cranes were scarce; the authorities pressed collection urgently, and a single feather could cost several hundred cash—the people suffered greatly.
translations.idiomatic: Cranes were scarce, and the authorities pressed collection urgently. A single feather could cost several hundred cash, and the people suffered greatly.

sentences.zh: 濟諭民取鵝翎代輸，仍驛奏其事，因詔旁郡悉如濟所陳。

translations.literal: Ji instructed the people to substitute goose feathers and report by courier; an edict then ordered neighboring prefectures all to follow Ji's proposal.
translations.idiomatic: Ji instructed the people to substitute goose feathers and reported the matter by courier. An edict then ordered neighboring prefectures all to follow Ji's proposal.

sentences.zh: 縣有陂塘數百頃，為鄉豪斡其利，會歲旱，濟悉導之，分溉民田。

translations.literal: The county had dikes and ponds covering several hundred qing, monopolized by local magnates for profit; when drought came, Ji had them all opened and the water divided to irrigate the people's fields.
translations.idiomatic: The county had dikes and ponds covering several hundred qing, monopolized by local magnates for profit. When drought came, Ji had them all opened and the water divided to irrigate the people's fields.

sentences.zh: 汀州以銀冶構訟，十年不決，逮係數百人，轉運使使濟鞫之，才七日情得，止坐數人。

translations.literal: Tingzhou had a lawsuit over silver smelting that had gone ten years unresolved, with several hundred people detained; the transport commissioner had Ji try the case—in only seven days the facts were clear, and only a few were punished.
translations.idiomatic: Tingzhou had a lawsuit over silver smelting that had gone unresolved for ten years, with several hundred people detained. The transport commissioner had Ji try the case. In only seven days the facts were clear, and only a few were punished.

sentences.zh: 再調胙城尉，徙臨河主簿。

translations.literal: He was transferred again to be marshal of Zuocheng and then moved to registrar of Linhe.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred again to serve as marshal of Zuocheng and then moved to registrar of Linhe.

sentences.zh: 轉運使王嗣宗被詔舉法官，以濟名聞。

translations.literal: Transport commissioner Wang Sizong was ordered by edict to recommend legal officials, and Ji's name became known.
translations.idiomatic: Transport commissioner Wang Sizong was ordered by edict to recommend legal officials, and Ji's name became known.

sentences.zh: 遷光祿寺丞、權大理丞，改刑部詳覆官、通判鎮州。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Acting Director of the Grand Court of Justice, then made Reviewing Official of the Penal Bureau and Vice Prefect of Zhenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Acting Director of the Grand Court of Justice, then made Reviewing Official of the Penal Bureau and vice prefect of Zhenzhou.

sentences.zh: 牧守多勳舊武臣，倨貴陵下，濟未嘗撓屈。

translations.literal: The prefectural governors were mostly meritorious old military men, arrogant and overbearing toward subordinates—Ji never yielded.
translations.idiomatic: The prefectural governors were mostly meritorious old military men, arrogant and overbearing toward subordinates, yet Ji never yielded.

sentences.zh: 戍卒頗恣暴不法，夜或焚民舍為盜。

translations.literal: Garrison soldiers were quite lawless and violent; at night they sometimes burned people's houses to rob as bandits.
translations.idiomatic: The garrison soldiers were quite lawless and violent. At night they sometimes burned people's houses in order to rob as bandits.

sentences.zh: 一夕，報有火，濟部壯士數十潛往偵伺，果得數輩並所盜物，即斬之。

translations.literal: One night a fire was reported; Ji deployed several dozen stout men in secret to watch; they indeed caught several men along with the stolen goods and immediately beheaded them.
translations.idiomatic: One night a fire was reported. Ji deployed several dozen stout men in secret to watch and indeed caught several men along with the stolen goods, whom he immediately beheaded.

sentences.zh: 馳奏其事，太宗大悅。

translations.literal: He rushed a memorial reporting the affair, and Taizong was greatly pleased.
translations.idiomatic: He rushed a memorial reporting the affair, and Taizong was greatly pleased.

sentences.zh: 都校孫進使酒無賴，毆折人齒，濟不俟奏，杖脊送闕下，繇是軍城畏肅。

translations.literal: Commandant Sun Jin drank and was a ruffian, beating a man and breaking his teeth; Ji without waiting for memorial had him flogged and sent to the capital, and thereafter the military garrison feared discipline.
translations.idiomatic: Commandant Sun Jin drank and was a ruffian, beating a man and breaking his teeth. Without waiting for memorial, Ji had him flogged and sent to the capital, and thereafter the military garrison feared discipline.

sentences.zh: 就遷太子中舍，詔書獎勞。

translations.literal: He was concurrently promoted to Palace Attendant of the Heir Apparent, and an edict commended and rewarded him.
translations.idiomatic: He was concurrently promoted to Palace Attendant of the Heir Apparent, and an edict commended and rewarded him.

sentences.zh: 召判登聞鼓院，拜監察御史。

translations.literal: He was summoned to judge the Drum Court of Appeals and appointed Investigating Censor.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned to judge the Drum Court of Appeals and appointed Investigating Censor.

sentences.zh: 上疏陳統天下之術、節民物之道，大者有十：擇左右，別賢愚，正名器，去冗食，加奉祿，謹政教，選良將，分兵戍，修民事，開仕進。

translations.literal: He submitted a memorial setting forth the art of governing all under Heaven and the way to economize on the people's resources; the great points were ten: choose those at one's side, distinguish worthy from foolish, correct names and ranks, remove redundant consumption, increase salaries, be careful in government and education, select good generals, distribute military garrisons, repair civil affairs, and open the path of advancement.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted a memorial setting forth the art of governing all under Heaven and the way to economize on the people's resources. The great points were ten: choose those at one's side, distinguish the worthy from the foolish, correct names and ranks, remove redundant consumption, increase salaries, be careful in government and education, select good generals, distribute military garrisons, repair civil affairs, and open the path of advancement.

sentences.zh: 其言切於時，詞多不載。

translations.literal: His words were pertinent to the times; most of the text is not recorded.
translations.idiomatic: His words were pertinent to the times, but most of the text is not recorded.

sentences.zh: 咸平初，濟以刑網尚繁，建議請刪定制敕，乃命張齊賢領其事，濟預焉。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xianping, Ji held that the penal net was still too dense and proposed editing the statutory commands; Zhang Qixian was ordered to lead the task, and Ji participated.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Xianping era, Ji held that the penal net was still too dense and proposed editing the statutory commands. Zhang Qixian was ordered to lead the task, and Ji participated.

sentences.zh: 《刑統》舊條：持仗行劫，不以贓有無，悉抵死。

translations.literal: An old provision of the Penal Compendium: robbery while bearing weapons, whether or not booty was obtained, all punished by death.
translations.idiomatic: An old provision of the Penal Compendium held that robbery while bearing weapons, whether or not booty was obtained, was punished by death in every case.

sentences.zh: 齊賢議貨不得財者，濟曰：「刑，期於無刑。

translations.literal: Qixian proposed that those who obtained no goods should be treated differently; Ji said: "Punishment aims at having no punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Qixian proposed that those who obtained no goods should be treated differently. Ji said, "Punishment aims at having no punishment.

sentences.zh: 以死懼之，尚不畏，況緩其死乎？

translations.literal: If even death does not frighten them, how much less would easing the death penalty?"
translations.idiomatic: If even death does not frighten them, how much less would easing the death penalty?"

sentences.zh: 」因與齊賢廷爭數四。

translations.literal: He thus disputed with Qixian at court several times.
translations.idiomatic: He thus disputed with Qixian at court several times.

sentences.zh: 濟詞氣甚厲，目齊賢為腐儒。

translations.literal: Ji's tone was very fierce; he called Qixian a pedantic Confucian.
translations.idiomatic: Ji's tone was very fierce, and he called Qixian a pedantic Confucian.

sentences.zh: 然卒從齊賢議，人以濟為刻。

translations.literal: Yet in the end they followed Qixian's proposal, and people regarded Ji as harsh.
translations.idiomatic: Yet in the end they followed Qixian's proposal, and people regarded Ji as harsh.

sentences.zh: 改鹽鐵判官。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Salt and Iron Judge.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Salt and Iron Judge.

sentences.zh: 車駕巡師大名，調丁夫十五萬修黃、汴河，濟以為勞民，詔濟馳往經度，還奏省十六七。

translations.literal: When the imperial carriage toured troops at Daming, 150,000 corvée laborers were levied to repair the Yellow and Bian rivers; Ji held it overburdened the people; an edict ordered Ji to rush there to plan it; on return he reported a savings of six or seven tenths.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial carriage toured troops at Daming, 150,000 corvée laborers were levied to repair the Yellow and Bian rivers. Ji held that the project overburdened the people, and an edict ordered him to rush there to plan it. On his return he reported a savings of six or seven tenths.

sentences.zh: 齊賢時為相，以河決為憂。

translations.literal: Qixian was then chancellor and worried about river breaches.
translations.idiomatic: Qixian was then chancellor and worried about river breaches.

sentences.zh: 因對，並召濟見，齊賢請令濟署狀保河不決，濟曰：「河決亦陰陽災沴，宰相苟能和陰陽，弭災沴，為國家致太平，河之不決，臣亦可保。

translations.literal: During an audience, Ji was also summoned; Qixian asked Ji to sign a guarantee that the river would not breach; Ji said: "River breaches also arise from disharmony of yin and yang and calamitous anomalies. If the chancellor can harmonize yin and yang and quell calamitous anomalies, bringing Great Peace to the state, that the river will not breach—I too can guarantee."
translations.idiomatic: During an audience Ji was also summoned. Qixian asked Ji to sign a guarantee that the river would not breach. Ji said, "River breaches also arise from disharmony of yin and yang and calamitous anomalies. If the chancellor can harmonize yin and yang and quell calamitous anomalies, bringing Great Peace to the state, then that the river will not breach—I too can guarantee."

sentences.zh: 」齊賢曰：「若是，則今非太平邪？

translations.literal: Qixian said: "If so, is the present not Great Peace?"
translations.idiomatic: Qixian said, "If so, is the present not Great Peace?"

sentences.zh: 」濟曰：「北有契丹，西有繼遷，兩河、關右歲被侵擾。

translations.literal: Ji said: "In the north there is Khitan, in the west Jiqian; the Two He and the western frontier suffer incursions year after year."
translations.idiomatic: Ji said, "In the north there is Khitan, in the west Jiqian. The Two He and the western frontier suffer incursions year after year."

sentences.zh: 以陛下神武英略，苟用得其人，可以馴致，今則未也。

translations.literal: With Your Majesty's divine martial prowess and heroic strategy, if the right men were employed, this could be subdued—but that has not yet been achieved.
translations.idiomatic: With Your Majesty's divine martial prowess and heroic strategy, if the right men were employed, this could be subdued—but that has not yet been achieved.

sentences.zh: 」上動容，獨留濟問邊事。

translations.literal: The emperor was moved; he kept Ji alone to question him on border affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was moved and kept Ji alone to question him on border affairs.

sentences.zh: 濟曰：「陛下承二聖之基，擁百萬之眾，蠢茲醜虜，敢爾憑陵，蓋謀謨當國之人未有如昔之比。

translations.literal: Ji said: "Your Majesty inherits the foundation of the Two Sage Emperors and commands a million men—yet these vile barbarians dare thus to encroach, because those who counsel the state today are not what they once were."
translations.idiomatic: Ji said, "Your Majesty inherits the foundation of the Two Sage Emperors and commands a million men, yet these vile barbarians dare thus to encroach because those who counsel the state today are not what they once were."

sentences.zh: 臣謂國家所恃，獨一洪河耳！

translations.literal: I hold that what the state relies upon is only the mighty Yellow River!
translations.idiomatic: I hold that what the state relies upon is only the mighty Yellow River!

sentences.zh: 此誠急賢之秋；

translations.literal: This is truly a season demanding urgent recruitment of the worthy.
translations.idiomatic: This is truly a season demanding urgent recruitment of the worthy.

sentences.zh: 不然，臣懼敵人將飲馬於河渚矣。

translations.literal: Otherwise, I fear the enemy will soon water their horses at the river's shallows.
translations.idiomatic: Otherwise, I fear the enemy will soon water their horses at the river's shallows.

sentences.zh: 」又著《備邊策》十五條以獻。

translations.literal: He also composed and presented "Fifteen Stratagems for Border Defense."
translations.idiomatic: He also composed and presented Fifteen Stratagems for Border Defense.

sentences.zh: 三年，選官判大理寺，上曰：「法寺宜擇當官不回者，苟非其人，或有冤濫，即感傷和氣。

translations.literal: In the third year, officials were selected to judge the Grand Court of Justice; the emperor said: "The Court of Justice should choose men in office who do not bend; if not the right men, there may be false convictions or excess punishments, which would harm harmonious qi.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year officials were selected to judge the Grand Court of Justice. The emperor said, "The Court of Justice should choose men in office who do not bend. If not the right men, there may be false convictions or excess punishments, which would harm harmonious qi.

sentences.zh: 王濟近數言事，似有操持，可試之。

translations.literal: Wang Ji has recently spoken on many affairs and seems to have firm principles—he may be tried."
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ji has recently spoken on many affairs and seems to have firm principles. He may be tried."

sentences.zh: 」遂令濟權判大理寺事。

translations.literal: Ji was then ordered to act as judge of the Grand Court of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: Ji was then ordered to act as judge of the Grand Court of Justice.

sentences.zh: 福津尉劉瑩集僧舍，屠狗群飲，杖一伶官致死，濟論以大辟，遇赦從流。

translations.literal: Fucun Assistant Liu Ying gathered at a temple, slaughtered a dog and drank in company, and beat an entertainer to death; Ji sentenced him to capital punishment; he received amnesty and was commuted to exile.
translations.idiomatic: Fucun Assistant Liu Ying gathered at a temple, slaughtered a dog and drank in company, and beat an entertainer to death. Ji sentenced him to capital punishment, but he received amnesty and was commuted to exile.

sentences.zh: 時王欽若知審刑，與濟素不相得，又以濟嘗忤齊賢，乃奏瑩當以德音原釋。

translations.literal: At the time Wang Qinruo oversaw criminal review; he and Ji had long been at odds, and because Ji had once offended Qixian, he memorialized that Ying should be pardoned under the amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Wang Qinruo oversaw criminal review. He and Ji had long been at odds, and because Ji had once offended Qixian, Qinruo memorialized that Ying should be pardoned under the amnesty.

sentences.zh: 齊賢、王欽若議濟坐故入，停官。

translations.literal: Qixian and Wang Qinruo held that Ji was guilty of intentional misjudgment and suspended him from office.
translations.idiomatic: Qixian and Wang Qinruo held that Ji was guilty of intentional misjudgment and suspended him from office.

sentences.zh: 逾年，復為監察御史、通判河南府。

translations.literal: After a year he was again made Investigating Censor and Vice Prefect of Henan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: After a year he was again made Investigating Censor and vice prefect of Henan prefecture.

sentences.zh: 景德初，徙知河中府。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jingde he was transferred to govern Hezhong prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Jingde era he was transferred to serve as prefect of Hezhong.

sentences.zh: 契丹南侵，上幸澶淵，詔緣河斷橋梁，毀船舫，稽緩者論以軍法。

translations.literal: When Khitan invaded south, the emperor went to Chanyuan; an edict ordered that bridges along the river be broken and boats destroyed; those who delayed were punished by military law.
translations.idiomatic: When the Khitan invaded south, the emperor went to Chanyuan. An edict ordered that bridges along the river be broken and boats destroyed, and those who delayed were punished by military law.

sentences.zh: 濟曰：「陝西有關防隔閡，舳艫遠屬，軍儲數萬，一旦沉之，可惜；

translations.literal: Ji said: "Shaanxi has fortifications and barriers; ships extend far in linkage, with military stores numbering in the tens of thousands—to sink them at once would be a pity;
translations.idiomatic: Ji said, "Shaanxi has fortifications and barriers. Ships extend far in linkage, with military stores numbering in the tens of thousands. To sink them at once would be a pity;

sentences.zh: 又動搖民心。

translations.literal: It would also shake the people's hearts."
translations.idiomatic: it would also shake the people's hearts."

sentences.zh: 」因密奏寢其事，上深嘉歎，遣使褒諭。

translations.literal: He thereupon secretly memorialized to halt the matter; the emperor deeply praised and sighed, and sent envoys to commend him.
translations.idiomatic: He thereupon secretly memorialized to halt the matter. The emperor deeply praised and sighed, and sent envoys to commend him.

sentences.zh: 未幾，召拜工部員外郎兼侍御史知雜事。

translations.literal: Before long he was summoned and appointed Vice Director of the Works Bureau and concurrently Chief Palace Censor.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was summoned and appointed Vice Director of the Works Bureau and concurrently Chief Palace Censor.

sentences.zh: 三年，判司農寺。

translations.literal: In the third year he judged the Court of Granaries.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he judged the Court of Granaries.

sentences.zh: 時周伯星見，濟乘間言曰：「昔唐太宗以豐年為上瑞。

translations.literal: When the star Zhoubo appeared, Ji seized the occasion and said: "In antiquity Emperor Taizong of Tang took abundant harvest years as the highest auspice.
translations.idiomatic: When the star Zhoubo appeared, Ji seized the occasion and said, "In antiquity Emperor Taizong of Tang took abundant harvest years as the highest auspice.

sentences.zh: 臣願陛下日慎一日，居安慮危，則天下幸甚。

translations.literal: I wish Your Majesty would grow more cautious day by day, and in security consider danger—then all under Heaven would be greatly blessed."
translations.idiomatic: I wish Your Majesty would grow more cautious day by day and, in security, consider danger. Then all under Heaven would be greatly blessed."

sentences.zh: 」受詔與劉綜改定茶法，頗易舊制，由是忤丁謂、林特、劉承規輩，因與欽若迭詆訾之。

translations.literal: He received an edict to join Liu Zong in revising the tea law, greatly altering the old system; thereby he offended Ding Wei, Lin Te, Liu Chenggui and their ilk, and together with Qinruo they took turns slandering and reviling him.
translations.idiomatic: He received an edict to join Liu Zong in revising the tea law, altering the old system considerably. Thereby he offended Ding Wei, Lin Te, Liu Chenggui, and others like them, and Qinruo together with them took turns slandering and reviling him.

sentences.zh: 四年，拜本曹郎中，出知杭州。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was appointed Director of the Department of his own bureau and sent out as prefect of Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was appointed Director of the Department of his own bureau and sent out to serve as prefect of Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 上面加慰諭，仍戒以朝廷闕失許密上言。

translations.literal: The emperor added words of consolation and encouragement, and also admonished him that regarding the court's faults and omissions he was permitted to memorialize secretly.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor added words of consolation and encouragement, and also instructed him that where the court had faults or omissions, he was permitted to memorialize in secret.

sentences.zh: 遷刑部郎中。

translations.literal: He was transferred to be Director of the Department in the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Director of the Department in the Ministry of Justice.

sentences.zh: 郡城西有錢塘湖，溉田千餘頃，歲久湮塞。

translations.literal: West of the prefectural city was Qiantang Lake, irrigating over a thousand qing of fields; over the years it had silted up and become blocked.
translations.idiomatic: West of the prefectural city lay Qiantang Lake, which irrigated more than a thousand qing of fields, but over the years it had silted up and become blocked.

sentences.zh: 濟命工浚治，增置斗門，以備潰溢之患，仍以白居易舊記刻石湖側，民頗利之。

translations.literal: Ji ordered workers to dredge and repair it, added sluice gates to guard against breach and overflow, and also had Bai Juyi's old inscription carved on stone by the lake; the people benefited greatly.
translations.idiomatic: Ji ordered workers to dredge and repair the lake, added sluice gates to guard against breach and overflow, and had Bai Juyi's old inscription carved in stone beside the lake. The people benefited greatly.

sentences.zh: 睦州有狂僧突人州廨，出妖言，與轉運使陳堯佐按其實，斬之，上嘉其能斷。

translations.literal: In Muzhou a mad monk burst into the prefectural office and uttered demonic words; together with Transport Commissioner Chen Yaozuo he investigated the facts and executed him; the emperor praised his ability to decide.
translations.idiomatic: In Muzhou a mad monk burst into the prefectural offices and uttered demonic words. Together with Transport Commissioner Chen Yaozuo, Ji investigated the matter and had the monk executed. The emperor praised his decisiveness.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符三年，徙知洪州，兼江南西路安撫使。

translations.literal: In the third year of Dazhong Xiangfu he was transferred to serve as prefect of Hongzhou, concurrently Military Commissioner of Jiangnan West Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Dazhong Xiangfu he was transferred to serve as prefect of Hongzhou and concurrently as Military Commissioner of Jiangnan West Circuit.

sentences.zh: 屬歲旱民饑，躬督官吏為糜粥，日親嘗而給之；

translations.literal: It happened that the year was drought-stricken and the people were starving; he personally supervised officials in making gruel, tasting it daily himself before distributing it;
translations.idiomatic: That year brought drought and famine. He personally supervised officials in preparing gruel, tasting it himself each day before distributing it;

sentences.zh: 錄饑民為州兵，全活甚眾。

translations.literal: He enrolled starving people as prefectural troops, saving very many lives.
translations.idiomatic: He enrolled starving people in the prefectural militia, thereby saving a great many lives.

sentences.zh: 是歲卒，年五十九，遺奏大旨以進賢退諛佞、罷土木不急之費為言。

translations.literal: That year he died, aged fifty-nine; his death memorial's main points spoke of advancing the worthy and removing flatterers and sycophants, and abolishing non-urgent construction expenses.
translations.idiomatic: He died that year at the age of fifty-nine. His death memorial stressed advancing the worthy and removing flatterers and sycophants, and abolishing non-urgent construction expenses.

sentences.zh: 濟頗涉經史，好讀《左氏春秋》，性剛直，無所畏避。

translations.literal: Ji was well versed in the classics and histories, fond of reading the Zuo Commentary to the Spring and Autumn Annals; by nature he was upright and stern, fearing and avoiding nothing.
translations.idiomatic: Ji was well versed in the classics and histories and fond of reading the Zuo Commentary to the Spring and Autumn Annals. By nature he was upright and stern and feared nothing.

sentences.zh: 少時，深州刺史念金鎖一見器之，且托後於濟。

translations.literal: In youth, Shenzhou Prefect Nian Jinsuo took a liking to him at first sight and also entrusted his aftercare to Ji.
translations.idiomatic: In his youth, Shenzhou Prefect Nian Jinsuo took a liking to him at first sight and entrusted his posterity to Ji's care.

sentences.zh: 金鎖沒，濟撫其孤，援置祿仕。

translations.literal: When Jinsuo died, Ji nurtured his orphans and helped place them in salaried office.
translations.idiomatic: When Jinsuo died, Ji nurtured his orphans and secured salaried appointments for them.

sentences.zh: 素與內臣裴愈有隙，愈坐事，上怒甚，命憲府鞫之，濟適知雜事，力為辨理，遂獲輕典。

translations.literal: He had long been at odds with inner attendant Pei Yu; Yu was implicated in an affair, the emperor was greatly angered and ordered the censorate to interrogate him; Ji happened to be Chief Palace Censor and vigorously argued his case, whereupon Yu received a lighter punishment.
translations.idiomatic: He had long been at odds with inner attendant Pei Yu. When Yu was implicated in an affair, the emperor was greatly angered and ordered the censorate to interrogate him. Ji happened to be serving as Chief Palace Censor and vigorously argued his case, whereupon Yu received a lighter punishment.

sentences.zh: 子孝傑，國子博士。

translations.literal: His son Xiaojie was a Doctor of the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: His son Xiaojie served as a Doctor of the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 論曰：渭有清節，臨事多從便文。

translations.literal: The commentator says: Wei had pure integrity, but in handling affairs often followed expedient practice.
translations.idiomatic: The commentator says: Wei possessed pure integrity, yet in handling affairs he often followed expedient practice.

sentences.zh: 鼎好規畫。

translations.literal: Ding was fond of planning and design.
translations.idiomatic: Ding was fond of planning and design.

sentences.zh: 師道喜論世務。

translations.literal: Shidao delighted in discussing affairs of the age.
translations.idiomatic: Shidao delighted in discussing affairs of the age.

sentences.zh: 正辭按貪吏，辨冤獄。

translations.literal: Zhengci prosecuted corrupt officials and cleared wrongful cases.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengci prosecuted corrupt officials and cleared cases of wrongful conviction.

sentences.zh: 濟議論挺特，無所畏避。

translations.literal: Ji's opinions were exceptional and outstanding; he feared and avoided nothing.
translations.idiomatic: Ji's opinions were bold and outstanding, and he feared nothing.

sentences.zh: 五臣者，仕不過監司、郡守，而名稱甚茂，可尚哉。

translations.literal: These five ministers served no higher than transport/intendancy commissioners and prefects, yet their reputations were very flourishing—worthy of esteem indeed!
translations.idiomatic: These five men rose no higher than transport commissioners and prefects, yet their reputations flourished greatly—worthy of esteem indeed!

sentences.zh: 方偕，字齊古，興化莆田人。

translations.literal: Fang Xie, styled Qigu, was a native of Putian in Xinghua.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Xie, whose style name was Qigu, came from Putian in Xinghua.

sentences.zh: 年二十，及進士第，為溫州軍事推官。

translations.literal: At age twenty he passed the jinshi examination and served as Military Push Officer of Wenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: At the age of twenty he passed the jinshi examination and served as Military Push Officer of Wenzhou.

sentences.zh: 歲饑，民欲隸軍就廩食，州不敢擅募。

translations.literal: In a year of famine the people wished to enlist in the army to receive grain rations, but the prefecture dared not recruit on its own authority.
translations.idiomatic: In a year of famine the people wished to enlist in the army to receive grain rations, but the prefecture dared not recruit on its own authority.

sentences.zh: 偕乃詣提點刑獄呂夷簡曰：「民迫流亡，不早募之，將聚而為盜矣。

translations.literal: Xie thereupon went to Judicial Intendant Lü Yijian and said: "The people are being driven to flee; if we do not recruit them soon, they will gather and become bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Xie thereupon went to Judicial Intendant Lü Yijian and said, "The people are being driven to flee. If we do not recruit them soon, they will gather and become bandits.

sentences.zh: 」夷簡從之，籍為軍者七千人。

translations.literal: Yijian agreed, and seven thousand men were registered in the army.
translations.idiomatic: Yijian agreed, and seven thousand men were registered in the army.

sentences.zh: 後遷汀州判官，權知建安縣。

translations.literal: Later he was transferred to be Assistant Magistrate of Tingzhou and acted as magistrate of Jian'an County.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was transferred to serve as Assistant Magistrate of Tingzhou and acted as magistrate of Jian'an County.

sentences.zh: 縣產茶，每歲先社日，調民數千鼓噪山旁，以達陽氣。

translations.literal: The county produced tea; every year before the She Festival day, several thousand people were mobilized to drum and shout beside the mountains, so as to reach the yang qi.
translations.idiomatic: The county produced tea. Every year before the She Festival, several thousand people were mobilized to drum and shout beside the mountains in order to summon the yang qi.

sentences.zh: 偕以為害農，奏罷之。

translations.literal: Xie considered this harmful to farming and memorialized to abolish it.
translations.idiomatic: Xie considered this harmful to farming and memorialized to have it abolished.

sentences.zh: 遷秘書省著作佐郎，曆知福清、資陽縣。

translations.literal: He was transferred to be Assistant Editor in the Secretariat and successively served as magistrate of Fuqing and Ziyang counties.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to serve as Assistant Editor in the Secretariat and successively served as magistrate of Fuqing and Ziyang counties.

sentences.zh: 累遷尚書屯田員外郎，為御史臺推直官。

translations.literal: After repeated promotions he became Vice Director of the Field Cultivation Bureau in the Ministry of Revenue and served as Investigating Officer of the Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: After repeated promotions he became Vice Director of the Field Cultivation Bureau in the Ministry of Revenue and served as Investigating Officer of the Censorate.

sentences.zh: 澧州逃卒傭民家自給，一日，誣告民事摩駝神，歲殺十二人以祭。

translations.literal: In Lizhou a deserter hired himself out to a civilian household for his keep; one day he falsely accused the household of worshipping the Motuo deity and sacrificing twelve people annually in offering.
translations.idiomatic: In Lizhou a deserter hired himself out to a civilian household for his keep. One day he falsely accused the household of worshipping the Motuo deity and sacrificing twelve people each year as offerings.

sentences.zh: 州逮其族三百人係獄，久不決。

translations.literal: The prefecture arrested three hundred members of the clan and imprisoned them; for a long time the case could not be decided.
translations.idiomatic: The prefecture arrested three hundred members of the clan and imprisoned them, and for a long time the case could not be decided.

sentences.zh: 偕被詔就劾，令卒疏所殺主名，按驗皆亡狀，事遂辨，卒以誣告論死。

translations.literal: Xie was ordered by edict to go investigate; he had the deserter list the names of those allegedly killed, and on verification all proved baseless; the matter was then cleared, and the deserter was sentenced to death for false accusation.
translations.idiomatic: Xie was ordered by edict to go and investigate. He had the deserter list the names of those allegedly killed, and on verification all proved baseless. The matter was then cleared, and the deserter was sentenced to death for false accusation.

sentences.zh: 知雜事龐籍薦為御史裏行，再遷侍御史。

translations.literal: Chief Palace Censor Pang Ji recommended him as Acting Censor, and after a further promotion he became Attending Censor.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Palace Censor Pang Ji recommended him as Acting Censor, and after a further promotion he became Attending Censor.

sentences.zh: 南京鴻慶宮災，偕引漢罷原廟故事，請勿復修。

translations.literal: When the Hongqing Palace in Nanjing burned, Xie cited the Han precedent of abolishing original ancestral temples and requested that it not be rebuilt.
translations.idiomatic: When the Hongqing Palace in Nanjing burned, Xie cited the Han precedent of abolishing original ancestral temples and requested that it not be rebuilt.

sentences.zh: 元昊寇塞門，鄜延副總管趙振逗撓不出救，詔偕往按之，法當斬。

translations.literal: When Yuan Hao raided Saimen, Deputy Commander-in-Chief Zhao Zhen of Fuyan hesitated and delayed and did not go out to rescue; an edict ordered Xie to go investigate him, and by law he should have been executed.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuan Hao raided Saimen, Deputy Commander-in-Chief Zhao Zhen of Fuyan hesitated and delayed and did not go out to rescue. An edict ordered Xie to investigate him, and by law he should have been executed.

sentences.zh: 偕奏：「兵寡不敵，苟出以餌賊，無益也。

translations.literal: Xie memorialized: "The troops were few and could not match the enemy; if they went out merely to feed the bandits, it would be of no benefit.
translations.idiomatic: Xie memorialized, "The troops were few and could not match the enemy. If they went out merely to feed the bandits, it would be of no benefit.

sentences.zh: 」振由是得不死。

translations.literal: Zhen thereby escaped death.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen thereby escaped death.

sentences.zh: 為開封府判官、江南安撫。

translations.literal: He served as Judge of the Kaifeng Prefecture and Military Commissioner of Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: He served as Judge of the Kaifeng Prefecture and Military Commissioner of Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 三司歲出乳香、綿綺下州郡配民，偕奏罷之。

translations.literal: Each year the Three Departments issued frankincense and silk brocade to prefectures and counties for distribution to the people; Xie memorialized to abolish this.
translations.idiomatic: Each year the Three Departments issued frankincense and silk brocade to prefectures and counties for distribution to the people. Xie memorialized to have this abolished.

sentences.zh: 更鹽鐵判官，遷兵部員外郎兼御史知雜事，言：「以罪謫監當者，監司勿得差權親民官。

translations.literal: He was reassigned as Salt and Iron Judge, promoted to Vice Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and concurrently Chief Palace Censor, and said: "Those demoted and exiled for crimes to supervisory posts—supervisory officials must not assign them as acting local officials who deal directly with the people.
translations.idiomatic: He was reassigned as Salt and Iron Judge and promoted to Vice Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and concurrently Chief Palace Censor. He said, "Those demoted and exiled for crimes to supervisory posts—supervisory officials must not assign them as acting local officials who deal directly with the people.

sentences.zh: 」判大理寺，改度支副使，擢天章閣待制、江淮製置發運使、知杭州，遷刑部郎中。

translations.literal: He judged the Grand Court of Justice, was changed to Vice Commissioner of the Revenue Bureau, was promoted to Hanlin Attendant-in-Waiting, Jiang-Huai Commissioner for Transport and Supply, and prefect of Hangzhou, and was transferred to Director of the Department in the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: He judged the Grand Court of Justice, was reassigned as Vice Commissioner of the Revenue Bureau, and was promoted to Hanlin Attendant-in-Waiting, Jiang-Huai Commissioner for Transport and Supply, and prefect of Hangzhou. He was then transferred to Director of the Department in the Ministry of Justice.

sentences.zh: 偕以吏事進，治杭州有能聲。

translations.literal: Xie advanced through administrative affairs; in governing Hangzhou he gained a reputation for ability.
translations.idiomatic: Xie advanced through administrative affairs, and in governing Hangzhou he gained a reputation for ability.

sentences.zh: 喜飲酒，至酣宴無節。

translations.literal: He was fond of drinking wine, and at feasts when drunk he had no restraint.
translations.idiomatic: He was fond of drinking wine, and at feasts when drunk he had no restraint.

sentences.zh: 數月，暴中風，以太常少卿分司西京，遷光祿卿，卒。

translations.literal: After several months he suddenly suffered a stroke, was made Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices with assignment to the Western Capital, was transferred to Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, and died.
translations.idiomatic: After several months he suddenly suffered a stroke, was assigned as Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices with duty in the Western Capital, was transferred to Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, and died.

sentences.zh: 曹穎叔

translations.literal: Cao Yingshu
translations.idiomatic: Cao Yingshu

sentences.zh: 曹穎叔，字秀之，亳州譙人。

translations.literal: Cao Yingshu, styled Xiuzhi, was a native of Qiao in Bozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Yingshu, whose style name was Xiuzhi, came from Qiao in Bozhou.

sentences.zh: 初名熙，嘗夢之官府，見穎叔名，遂更名穎叔。

translations.literal: His original name was Xi; once he dreamed of a government office and saw the name Yingshu, and so changed his name to Yingshu.
translations.idiomatic: His original name was Xi. Once he dreamed of a government office and saw the name Yingshu, and so changed his name to Yingshu.

sentences.zh: 進士及第，曆威勝軍判官、渭州軍事推官。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination and successively served as Assistant Magistrate of Weisheng Army and Military Push Officer of Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination and successively served as Assistant Magistrate of Weisheng Army and Military Push Officer of Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 御史中丞蔡齊薦為台主薄，改大理寺丞。

translations.literal: Censor-in-Chief Cai Qi recommended him as Chief Clerk of the Censorate, and he was changed to Assistant Magistrate of the Grand Court of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-Chief Cai Qi recommended him as Chief Clerk of the Censorate, and he was reassigned as Assistant Magistrate of the Grand Court of Justice.

sentences.zh: 韓億知亳州，辟僉書節度判官事，通判儀州。

translations.literal: When Han Yi was prefect of Bozhou, he recruited Yingshu as Signing Secretary for the Military Commission and made him Vice Prefect of Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Han Yi was prefect of Bozhou, he recruited Yingshu as Signing Secretary for the Military Commission and made him Vice Prefect of Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 韓琦、文彥博薦其才，徙夔州路轉運判官。

translations.literal: Han Qi and Wen Yanbo recommended his talent, and he was transferred to be Transport Vice Commissioner of Kuizhou Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Han Qi and Wen Yanbo recommended his talent, and he was transferred to serve as Transport Vice Commissioner of Kuizhou Circuit.

sentences.zh: 夔、峽尚淫祠，人有疾，不事醫而專事神，穎叔悉禁絕之，乃教以醫藥。

translations.literal: In Kuizhou and the Gorges region licentious shrines were still honored; when people fell ill they did not seek physicians but devoted themselves solely to spirits; Yingshu forbade all of this entirely and then taught them medicine.
translations.idiomatic: In Kuizhou and the Gorges region licentious shrines were still honored. When people fell ill they did not seek physicians but devoted themselves solely to spirits. Yingshu forbade all of this entirely and then taught them medicine.

sentences.zh: 提點陝西路刑獄，夏人納款，詔與戶部副使夏安期、轉運使柳灝減戍卒吏員之冗者。

translations.literal: As Judicial Intendant of Shaanxi West Circuit, when the Xia people submitted, an edict ordered him together with Vice Commissioner of the Households Bureau Xia Anqi and Transport Commissioner Liu Hao to reduce redundant garrison soldiers and clerks.
translations.idiomatic: As Judicial Intendant of Shaanxi West Circuit, when the Xia people submitted, an edict ordered him together with Vice Commissioner of the Households Bureau Xia Anqi and Transport Commissioner Liu Hao to reduce redundant garrison soldiers and clerks.

sentences.zh: 為開封府判官，時御史宋禧鞫衛士獄於內侍省，禧不能辨，及獄具，內侍使禧自為牒，穎叔言禧為製使辱命，請置之法。

translations.literal: While serving as Judge of the Kaifeng Prefecture, Attending Censor Song Xi was interrogating a guards case in the Inner Attendant Service; Xi could not determine the facts, and when the case was complete the inner attendants had Xi draft the document himself; Yingshu said Xi as envoy had disgraced his commission and requested that he be punished by law.
translations.idiomatic: While serving as Judge of the Kaifeng Prefecture, Attending Censor Song Xi was interrogating a guards case in the Inner Attendant Service. Xi could not determine the facts, and when the case was complete the inner attendants had Xi draft the document himself. Yingshu said Xi, as envoy, had disgraced his commission and requested that he be punished by law.

sentences.zh: 元昊死，為夏國祭奠使。

translations.literal: When Yuan Hao died, he served as condolence envoy to the Xia state.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuan Hao died, he served as condolence envoy to the Xia state.

sentences.zh: 除直史館、知鳳翔府，徙益州路轉運使，權度支副使。

translations.literal: He was appointed Direct Historiographer and prefect of Fengxiang Prefecture, was transferred to Transport Commissioner of Yizhou Circuit, and acted as Vice Commissioner of the Revenue Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Direct Historiographer and prefect of Fengxiang Prefecture, was transferred to Transport Commissioner of Yizhou Circuit, and acted as Vice Commissioner of the Revenue Bureau.

sentences.zh: 儂智高寇嶺南，朝議以閩中久弛兵備，擢天章閣待制、知福州。

translations.literal: When Nong Zhigao raided Lingnan, the court considered that military preparations in Minzhong had long been lax, and promoted him to Hanlin Attendant-in-Waiting and prefect of Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Nong Zhigao raided Lingnan, the court considered that military preparations in Minzhong had long been lax and promoted him to Hanlin Attendant-in-Waiting and prefect of Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 累遷右司郎中，為陝西都轉運使。

translations.literal: After repeated promotions he became Director of the Right Department and served as Chief Transport Commissioner of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: After repeated promotions he became Director of the Right Department and served as Chief Transport Commissioner of Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 自慶曆鑄大鐵錢行陝西，民盜鑄不已，三司上榷鐵之議。

translations.literal: Since the Qingli casting of large iron coins for circulation in Shaanxi, the people had ceaselessly counterfeited them; the Three Departments submitted a proposal for a state iron monopoly.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Qingli casting of large iron coins for circulation in Shaanxi, the people had ceaselessly counterfeited them. The Three Departments submitted a proposal for a state iron monopoly.

sentences.zh: 穎叔曰：「鐵錢輕而貨重，不可久行，況官自榷鐵乎？

translations.literal: Yingshu said: "Iron coins are light while goods are heavy; they cannot circulate for long—how much less if the state itself monopolizes iron?
translations.idiomatic: Yingshu said, "Iron coins are light while goods are heavy. They cannot circulate for long—how much less if the state itself monopolizes iron?

sentences.zh: 請罷鑄諸郡鐵錢，以三鐵錢當銅錢之一。

translations.literal: I request that the casting of iron coins in the various prefectures be abolished, and that three iron coins be valued as one copper coin.
translations.idiomatic: I request that the casting of iron coins in the various prefectures be abolished, and that three iron coins be valued as one copper coin.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 兩川和買絹給陝西兵，而蜀人苦於煩斂，穎叔為歲出本路緡錢五十萬，以易軍衣之餘者，兩川之民始無擾焉。

translations.literal: The Two Sichuan circuits supplied silk through cooperative procurement for Shaanxi troops, while the people of Shu suffered from burdensome levies; Yingshu arranged for his circuit to pay out five hundred thousand strings of cash annually to exchange for surplus military clothing, and only then did the people of the Two Sichuan circuits cease to be disturbed.
translations.idiomatic: The Two Sichuan circuits supplied silk through cooperative procurement for Shaanxi troops, while the people of Shu suffered from burdensome levies. Yingshu arranged for his circuit to pay out five hundred thousand strings of cash annually to exchange for surplus military clothing, and only then did the people of the Two Sichuan circuits cease to be disturbed.

sentences.zh: 進龍圖閣直學士、知永興軍；

translations.literal: He was promoted to Direct Academician of the Dragon Diagram Hall and prefect of Yongxing Army;
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Direct Academician of the Dragon Diagram Hall and prefect of Yongxing Army;

sentences.zh: 然年老，漸昏耄，事頗壅積，人或嘲誚之，卒於官。

translations.literal: But he was old and gradually became senile; affairs piled up greatly, and some people mocked him; he died in office.
translations.idiomatic: But he was old and gradually became senile. Affairs piled up greatly, and some people mocked him. He died in office.

sentences.zh: 劉元瑜

translations.literal: Liu Yuanyu
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yuanyu

sentences.zh: 劉元瑜，字君玉，河南人。

translations.literal: Liu Yuanyu, styled Junyu, was a native of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yuanyu, whose style name was Junyu, came from Henan.

sentences.zh: 進士及第，補舞陽縣主簿，改秘書省著作佐郎、知雍丘縣，通判隰、並二州，知郢州。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination, was appointed Chief Clerk of Wuyang County, was changed to Assistant Editor in the Secretariat and magistrate of Yongqiu County, served as Vice Prefect of Xi and Bing prefectures, and was prefect of Ezhou.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination, was appointed Chief Clerk of Wuyang County, was reassigned as Assistant Editor in the Secretariat and magistrate of Yongqiu County, served as Vice Prefect of Xi and Bing prefectures, and was prefect of Ezhou.

sentences.zh: 以太常博士為監察御史，上言：「考課之法，自朝廷至員外郎、郎中、少卿，須清望官五人保任始得遷，故浮薄輩日趨權門，非所以養廉恥也。

translations.literal: As Doctor of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices he became Investigating Censor and memorialized: "Under the merit-evaluation law, from court officials down to Vice Directors, Directors, and Vice Ministers, five officials of distinguished reputation must guarantee one before promotion is permitted; therefore the frivolous and shallow daily throng the gates of power—this is not the way to nurture integrity and shame.
translations.idiomatic: As Doctor of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices he became Investigating Censor and memorialized, "Under the merit-evaluation law, from court officials down to Vice Directors, Directors, and Vice Ministers, five officials of distinguished reputation must guarantee one before promotion is permitted. Therefore the frivolous and shallow daily throng the gates of power—this is not the way to nurture integrity and shame.

sentences.zh: 」詔罷之。

translations.literal: An edict abolished it.
translations.idiomatic: An edict abolished it.

sentences.zh: 提舉河北便糴。

translations.literal: He was appointed to oversee convenient grain purchases in Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed to oversee convenient grain purchases in Hebei.

sentences.zh: 會永寧雲翼軍士謀為變，吏窮捕，黨與謀劫囚以反，百姓竊知多逃避。

translations.literal: It happened that soldiers of the Yunyi Army at Yongning plotted mutiny; officials pursued them to the limit, and their associates plotted to seize prisoners in revolt; the people secretly learned of this and many fled.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that soldiers of the Yunyi Army at Yongning plotted mutiny. Officials pursued them to the limit, and their associates plotted to seize prisoners in revolt. The people secretly learned of this and many fled.

sentences.zh: 元瑜馳至，斬為首者，其餘皆釋去不問。

translations.literal: Yuanyu rushed there, executed the ringleaders, and released the rest without further inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanyu rushed there, executed the ringleaders, and released the rest without further inquiry.

sentences.zh: 曆京西、河東轉運使，遷右司諫。

translations.literal: He successively served as Transport Commissioner of Jingxi and Hedong circuits and was transferred to Remonstrance Officer of the Right Department.
translations.idiomatic: He successively served as Transport Commissioner of Jingxi and Hedong circuits and was transferred to Remonstrance Officer of the Right Department.

sentences.zh: 劾奏「集賢校理陸經謫官在河南日，杖死爭田寡婦，且貸民鏹，監司列薦其才，投托權要，遂復館職，請重置於法，並坐保薦者。

translations.literal: He impeached and memorialized: "Collator Lu Jing, while demoted and serving in Henan, beat a widow disputing fields to death, and also lent money to the people; supervisory officials listed and recommended his talent, he relied on powerful patrons, and thus regained his post in the Academy— I request that he again be punished by law, and that those who recommended him be punished as well.
translations.idiomatic: He impeached and memorialized, "Collator Lu Jing, while demoted and serving in Henan, beat a widow disputing fields to death, and also lent money to the people. Supervisory officials listed and recommended his talent, he relied on powerful patrons, and thus regained his post in the Academy. I request that he again be punished by law, and that those who recommended him be punished as well.

sentences.zh: 」詔屬吏，遂竄經袁州。

translations.literal: An edict assigned the matter to officials, and Jing was banished to Yuanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: An edict assigned the matter to officials, and Jing was banished to Yuanzhou.

sentences.zh: 又疏「李用和、曹琮、李昭亮不可典軍；

translations.literal: He also submitted a memorial: "Li Yonghe, Cao Zong, and Li Zhaoliang should not command armies;
translations.idiomatic: He also submitted a memorial: "Li Yonghe, Cao Zong, and Li Zhaoliang should not command armies;

sentences.zh: 梁適不當翰林學士；

translations.literal: Liang Shi should not be Hanlin Academician;
translations.idiomatic: Liang Shi should not be Hanlin Academician;

sentences.zh: 范仲淹以非罪貶，既復天章閣待制，宜在左右；

translations.literal: Fan Zhongyan was demoted for a crime he did not commit; now that he has been restored as Hanlin Attendant-in-Waiting, he should be kept close at hand;
translations.idiomatic: Fan Zhongyan was demoted for a crime he did not commit. Now that he has been restored as Hanlin Attendant-in-Waiting, he should be kept close at hand;

sentences.zh: 尹洙、余靖、歐陽修皆以朋黨斥逐。

translations.literal: Yin Shu, Yu Jing, and Ouyang Xiu were all expelled as faction members.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Shu, Yu Jing, and Ouyang Xiu were all expelled as faction members.

sentences.zh: 此小人惡直醜正者也。

translations.literal: These are petty men who hate the upright and revile the correct.
translations.idiomatic: These are petty men who hate the upright and revile the correct.

sentences.zh: 」既而與靖等相失，反言：「前除夏竦為樞密使，諫臣數人摭其舊過，召至都門而罷之。

translations.literal: Later he fell out with Jing and the others and turned about to say: "Previously when Xia Song was appointed Military Affairs Commissioner, several remonstrance officials seized on his old faults, summoned him to the capital gate, and had him dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Later he fell out with Jing and the others and turned about to say, "Previously when Xia Song was appointed Military Affairs Commissioner, several remonstrance officials seized on his old faults, summoned him to the capital gate, and had him dismissed.

sentences.zh: 自此以進退大臣為己任，激訐陰私為忠直，薦延輕薄，列之館閣，以唱和為朋比。

translations.literal: From then on they made advancing and dismissing great ministers their own task, treating exposure of private faults as loyalty and uprightness, recommending and extending the frivolous, placing them in the academies and halls, and taking mutual verse-making as factional alliance.
translations.idiomatic: From then on they made advancing and dismissing great ministers their own task, treating exposure of private faults as loyalty and uprightness, recommending and extending the frivolous, placing them in the academies and halls, and taking mutual verse-making as factional alliance.

sentences.zh: 近除兩府，出自聖斷，獨黨人以進用不出於己，議論紛然，臣恐復被疏罷矣。

translations.literal: Recently appointments to the Two Departments came from the sage decision alone, yet the faction members alone resented that promotions did not come from themselves; debate was clamorous, and I fear I shall again be dismissed by memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Recently appointments to the Two Departments came from the sage decision alone, yet the faction members alone resented that promotions did not come from themselves. Debate was clamorous, and I fear I shall again be dismissed by memorial.

sentences.zh: 前日孫甫薦葉清臣，毀丁度，效此也。

translations.literal: The other day Sun Fu recommended Ye Qingchen and slandered Ding Du—this follows the same pattern.
translations.idiomatic: The other day Sun Fu recommended Ye Qingchen and slandered Ding Du—this follows the same pattern.

sentences.zh: 」因論：「靖知制誥不宜兼領諫職，且奉使契丹，對契丹主，效六國語，辱國命，請加罪。

translations.literal: He therefore argued: "Jing, as Drafting Official, should not concurrently hold remonstrance office, and moreover when sent as envoy to the Khitan he addressed the Khitan ruler in the language of the Six States, disgracing the commission of the state— I request that he be punished.
translations.idiomatic: He therefore argued, "Jing, as Drafting Official, should not concurrently hold remonstrance office. Moreover, when sent as envoy to the Khitan he addressed the Khitan ruler in the language of the Six States, disgracing the commission of the state. I request that he be punished.

sentences.zh: 」修、靖深惡之，繇是論者以元瑜為奸邪。

translations.literal: Xiu and Jing deeply hated him, and from this commentators regarded Yuanyu as treacherous and evil.
translations.idiomatic: Xiu and Jing deeply hated him, and from this commentators regarded Yuanyu as treacherous and evil.

sentences.zh: 後除三司鹽錢副使，以天章閣待制知潭州。

translations.literal: Later he was appointed Vice Commissioner of the Salt and Coin Bureau and served as Hanlin Attendant-in-Waiting and prefect of Tanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was appointed Vice Commissioner of the Salt and Coin Bureau and served as Hanlin Attendant-in-Waiting and prefect of Tanzhou.

sentences.zh: 徭人數為寇，元瑜使州人楊謂入梅山，說酋長四百餘人出聽命，因厚犒之，籍以為民，凡千二百戶。

translations.literal: The Yao people repeatedly raided as bandits; Yuanyu sent a man of the prefecture, Yang Wei, into Meishan to persuade more than four hundred chieftains to come out and obey orders; he then rewarded them generously and registered them as commoners— altogether twelve hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: The Yao people repeatedly raided as bandits. Yuanyu sent a man of the prefecture, Yang Wei, into Meishan to persuade more than four hundred chieftains to come out and obey orders. He then rewarded them generously and registered them as commoners—altogether twelve hundred households.

sentences.zh: 徙桂州，固辭，降鄧州。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Guizhou, firmly declined, and was demoted to Dengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Guizhou, firmly declined, and was demoted to Dengzhou.

sentences.zh: 坐在潭州擅補畫工易元吉為畫助教，降知隨州。

translations.literal: Because while at Tanzhou he had on his own authority appointed the painter Yi Yuangji as Assistant Instructor of Painting, he was demoted to prefect of Suizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Because while at Tanzhou he had on his own authority appointed the painter Yi Yuangji as Assistant Instructor of Painting, he was demoted to prefect of Suizhou.

sentences.zh: 又失保任，改信州，徙襄州。

translations.literal: He again failed in his guarantee responsibility, was changed to Xizhou, and was transferred to Xiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He again failed in his guarantee responsibility, was reassigned to Xizhou, and was transferred to Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 富人子張銳少孤弱，同里車氏規取其財，乃取銳父棄妾他姓子養之。

translations.literal: Zhang Rui, son of a rich man, was young, orphaned, and weak; a man of the Che clan in the same village plotted to seize his property, and so took a child of another surname whom Rui's father had abandoned with a concubine and raised him.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Rui, son of a rich man, was young, orphaned, and weak. A man of the Che clan in the same village plotted to seize his property, and so took a child of another surname whom Rui's father had abandoned with a concubine and raised him.

sentences.zh: 比長，使自訴，陰賕吏為助，州斷使歸張氏，銳莫敢辨。

translations.literal: When the child grew up, he had him sue on his own behalf, secretly bribed officials to assist him, and the prefecture ruled that he should return to the Zhang clan; Rui dared not dispute it.
translations.idiomatic: When the child grew up, he had him sue on his own behalf, secretly bribed officials to assist him, and the prefecture ruled that he should return to the Zhang clan. Rui dared not dispute it.

sentences.zh: 既同居逾年，車即導令求析居。

translations.literal: After they had lived together for more than a year, the Che clan at once guided him to seek separate households.
translations.idiomatic: After they had lived together for more than a year, the Che clan at once guided him to seek separate households.

sentences.zh: 元瑜察知，窮治得奸狀，黥車竄之，人伏其明，曆河中府，以左諫議大夫知青州，卒。

translations.literal: Yuanyu detected this, pursued the investigation to the full and obtained proof of the fraud, branded the Che clan and banished them; people admired his clarity. He successively served in the Hezhong prefecture, was made Left Remonstrance Officer and prefect of Qingzhou, and died.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanyu detected this, pursued the investigation to the full and obtained proof of the fraud, branded the Che clan and banished them. People admired his clarity. He successively served in the Hezhong prefecture, was made Left Remonstrance Officer and prefect of Qingzhou, and died.

sentences.zh: 元瑜性貪，至竅販禁物，親與小人爭權，時論鄙之。

translations.literal: Yuanyu was greedy by nature, to the point of illicitly trafficking in prohibited goods, and personally contended for power with petty men; contemporary opinion despised him.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanyu was greedy by nature, to the point of illicitly trafficking in prohibited goods, and personally contended for power with petty men. Contemporary opinion despised him.

sentences.zh: 楊告，字道之，其先漢州綿竹人。

translations.literal: Yang Gao, styled Daozhi, his ancestors were natives of Mianzhu in Hanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Gao, whose style name was Daozhi, came from a family originally of Mianzhu in Hanzhou.

sentences.zh: 父允恭，西京左藏庫使，數任事有功。

translations.literal: His father Yungong was Director of the Left Treasury of the Western Capital and repeatedly served with merit.
translations.idiomatic: His father Yungong served as Director of the Left Treasury of the Western Capital and repeatedly performed meritorious service.

sentences.zh: 既死，賜告同學究出身，調廬江尉。

translations.literal: After Yungong died, Gao was granted the status of a fellow student and appointed Assistant Magistrate of Lujiang.
translations.idiomatic: After Yungong died, Gao was granted the status of a fellow student and was appointed Assistant Magistrate of Lujiang.

sentences.zh: 時張景笞吏死而吏捕急，逃歸告，懼告不見納，告曰：「君勿憂也，吾死生以之。

translations.literal: At the time Zhang Jing had beaten a clerk to death and the clerk's pursuers were pressing hard; the clerk fled back to Gao, fearing Gao would not accept him; Gao said: "Do not worry—I stake my life on this.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Zhang Jing had beaten a clerk to death and the clerk's pursuers were pressing hard. The clerk fled back to Gao, fearing Gao would not accept him. Gao said, "Do not worry—I stake my life on this.

sentences.zh: 」景卒免。

translations.literal: Jing was ultimately spared.
translations.idiomatic: Jing was ultimately spared.

sentences.zh: 改豐城主簿，邑有賊殺人，投屍於江，人知主名，而畏不敢言，告聞，親往擒賊。

translations.literal: He was changed to Chief Clerk of Fengcheng; in the district a bandit killed a man and threw the corpse into the river; people knew the culprit's name but feared to speak; when Gao heard of it he went in person to capture the bandit.
translations.idiomatic: He was reassigned as Chief Clerk of Fengcheng. In the district a bandit killed a man and threw the corpse into the river. People knew the culprit's name but feared to speak. When Gao heard of it he went in person to capture the bandit.

sentences.zh: 有言賊欲報怨者，告不為動。

translations.literal: Some said the bandit wished to take revenge; Gao was unmoved.
translations.idiomatic: Some said the bandit wished to take revenge, but Gao was unmoved.

sentences.zh: 既而果乘夜欲刺告，告又捕得，致於法，境內肅然。

translations.literal: Before long the bandit indeed came by night intending to assassinate Gao; Gao captured him again and punished him by law, and within the jurisdiction all was orderly.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the bandit indeed came by night intending to assassinate Gao. Gao captured him again and punished him by law, and within the jurisdiction all was orderly.

sentences.zh: 再調南劍州判官，知南安、六合、錢塘、寧國縣，改大理寺丞、通判江寧州。

translations.literal: He was transferred again to be Assistant Magistrate of Nanjian Prefecture, served as magistrate of Nan'an, Luhe, Qiantang, and Ningguo counties, was changed to Assistant Magistrate of the Grand Court of Justice, and served as Vice Prefect of Jiangning Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred again to serve as Assistant Magistrate of Nanjian Prefecture, served as magistrate of Nan'an, Luhe, Qiantang, and Ningguo counties, was reassigned as Assistant Magistrate of the Grand Court of Justice, and served as Vice Prefect of Jiangning Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 盜殺商人，鑿舟沉屍江中。

translations.literal: Bandits killed a merchant, bored holes in the boat, and sank the corpse in the river.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits killed a merchant, bored holes in the boat, and sank the corpse in the river.

sentences.zh: 有被誣告者笞服，獄具，告疑其無狀，後數日，果得真盜。

translations.literal: Someone was falsely accused and confessed under beating; when the case was complete Gao suspected it was baseless, and several days later the true bandits were indeed obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Someone was falsely accused and confessed under beating. When the case was complete Gao suspected it was baseless, and several days later the true bandits were indeed captured.

sentences.zh: 徙知池州，累遷尚書司封員外郎、開封府推官、開拆司。

translations.literal: He was transferred to serve as prefect of Chizhou, and after repeated promotions became Vice Director of the Seals Bureau in the Ministry of Revenue, Investigating Officer of the Kaifeng Prefecture, and of the Opening and Inspection Office.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to serve as prefect of Chizhou, and after repeated promotions became Vice Director of the Seals Bureau in the Ministry of Revenue, Investigating Officer of the Kaifeng Prefecture, and of the Opening and Inspection Office.

sentences.zh: 為趙元昊旌節官告使，元昊專席自尊大，告徙坐即賓位，莫之屈也。

translations.literal: He served as envoy bearing the commission and patent for Zhao Yuanhao; Yuanhao alone occupied the seat and was arrogant; Gao moved to sit in the guest seat, and none could bend him.
translations.idiomatic: He served as envoy bearing the commission and patent for Zhao Yuanhao. Yuanhao alone occupied the seat and acted arrogantly. Gao moved to sit in the guest seat, and none could bend him.

sentences.zh: 除京西轉運副使。

translations.literal: He was appointed Vice Transport Commissioner of Jingxi.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Vice Transport Commissioner of Jingxi.

sentences.zh: 屬部歲饑，所至發公廩，又募富室出粟賑之。

translations.literal: In his jurisdiction there was famine that year; wherever he went he opened public granaries and also recruited wealthy households to contribute grain for relief.
translations.idiomatic: In his jurisdiction there was famine that year. Wherever he went he opened public granaries and also recruited wealthy households to contribute grain for relief.

sentences.zh: 民伐桑易粟，不能售，告命高其估以給酒，官民獲濟者甚眾。

translations.literal: The people cut mulberry trees to exchange for grain but could not sell them; Gao ordered the valuation raised to supply wine, and very many officials and people were thereby relieved.
translations.idiomatic: The people cut mulberry trees to exchange for grain but could not sell them. Gao ordered the valuation raised to supply wine, and very many officials and people were thereby relieved.

sentences.zh: 以疾，權管勾西京留台。

translations.literal: Because of illness he was temporarily put in charge of the Western Capital Remainder Office.
translations.idiomatic: Because of illness he was temporarily put in charge of the Western Capital Remainder Office.

sentences.zh: 頃之，判三司憑由、理欠司，為淮南轉運使，徙製置發運使，除三司戶部副使，更度支，安撫河東，改鹽鐵副使。

translations.literal: Before long he judged the Three Departments' Credential and Arrears Offices, served as Transport Commissioner of Huainan, was transferred to Commissioner for Transport and Supply, was appointed Vice Commissioner of the Households Bureau, was reassigned to the Revenue Bureau, served as Military Commissioner of Hedong, and was changed to Vice Commissioner of the Salt and Iron Bureau.
