translations.idiomatic: Before long he judged the Three Departments' Credential and Arrears Offices, served as Transport Commissioner of Huainan, was transferred to Commissioner for Transport and Supply, was appointed Vice Commissioner of the Households Bureau, was reassigned to the Revenue Bureau, served as Military Commissioner of Hedong, and was changed to Vice Commissioner of the Salt and Iron Bureau.

sentences.zh: 曆祠部、度支、司封郎中，以少府監復為製置發運使。

translations.literal: He successively served as Director of the Departments of Sacrifices, Revenue, and Seals, and as Director of the Court of Imperial Manufactories again became Commissioner for Transport and Supply.
translations.idiomatic: He successively served as Director of the Departments of Sacrifices, Revenue, and Seals, and as Director of the Court of Imperial Manufactories again became Commissioner for Transport and Supply.

sentences.zh: 拜右諫議大夫、知鄭州，徙江寧府、壽州。

translations.literal: He was appointed Right Remonstrance Officer and prefect of Zhengzhou, and was transferred to Jiangning Prefecture and Shouzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Right Remonstrance Officer and prefect of Zhengzhou, and was transferred to Jiangning Prefecture and Shouzhou.

sentences.zh: 告曉法令，頗知財利，而不務苛刻，時號能吏，然喜事權貴以要進。

translations.literal: Gao understood laws and regulations, was well versed in finance, yet did not pursue harshness; at the time he was called an able official, but he delighted in serving the powerful and noble to seek advancement.
translations.idiomatic: Gao understood laws and regulations and was well versed in finance, yet did not pursue harshness. At the time he was called an able official, but he delighted in serving the powerful and noble to seek advancement.

sentences.zh: 一子，力學有文，數為近臣薦，召試，賜同進士出身，未幾卒。

translations.literal: He had one son who studied diligently and had literary talent; he was repeatedly recommended by close ministers, was summoned for examination, was granted the status of a fellow jinshi, and died before long.
translations.idiomatic: He had one son who studied diligently and had literary talent. The son was repeatedly recommended by close ministers, was summoned for examination, was granted the status of a fellow jinshi, and died before long.

sentences.zh: 告悲傷之，尋卒。

translations.literal: Gao grieved deeply and soon died himself.
translations.idiomatic: Gao grieved deeply and soon died himself.

sentences.zh: 趙及，字希之，其先幽州良鄉人。

translations.literal: Zhao Ji, styled Xizhi, his ancestors were natives of Liangxiang in Youzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Ji, whose style name was Xizhi, came from a family originally of Liangxiang in Youzhou.

sentences.zh: 父的，事契丹為蔚州靈丘令，雍熙中，王師北征，乃歸，授偃師令，因家焉。

translations.literal: His father Di served the Khitan as magistrate of Lingqiu in Weizhou; in the Yongxi era, when the imperial army marched north, he returned and was appointed magistrate of Yanshi, and thereupon made his home there.
translations.idiomatic: His father Di served the Khitan as magistrate of Lingqiu in Weizhou. In the Yongxi era, when the imperial army marched north, he returned and was appointed magistrate of Yanshi, and thereupon made his home there.

sentences.zh: 及舉進士，為慈州軍事推官，徙廣信軍判官，改秘書省著作佐郎、知魏縣，徙九隴，以母老監葉縣稅，曆黃河、御河催綱，通判青州、大名府，累遷尚書屯田員外郎，被舉為殿中侍御史、權宗正丞。

translations.literal: Ji passed the jinshi examination, served as Military Push Officer of Cizhou, was transferred to Assistant Magistrate of Guangxin Army, was changed to Assistant Editor in the Secretariat and magistrate of Wei County, was transferred to Jiulong, because his mother was old supervised the tax of Ye County, successively oversaw grain transport on the Yellow River and Imperial Canal, served as Vice Prefect of Qingzhou and Daming Prefecture, and after repeated promotions became Vice Director of the Field Cultivation Bureau in the Ministry of Revenue and was recommended as Attending Censor and Acting Director of the Imperial Clan Court.
translations.idiomatic: Ji passed the jinshi examination, served as Military Push Officer of Cizhou, was transferred to Assistant Magistrate of Guangxin Army, was reassigned as Assistant Editor in the Secretariat and magistrate of Wei County, was transferred to Jiulong, and because his mother was old supervised the tax of Ye County. He successively oversaw grain transport on the Yellow River and Imperial Canal, served as Vice Prefect of Qingzhou and Daming Prefecture, and after repeated promotions became Vice Director of the Field Cultivation Bureau in the Ministry of Revenue and was recommended as Attending Censor and Acting Director of the Imperial Clan Court.

sentences.zh: 詔劾夏守恩獄，內侍岑守中用賄撓法，及劾正其罪。

translations.literal: An edict ordered him to investigate the case of Xia Shou'en; inner attendant Cen Shouzhong used bribes to obstruct the law, and Ji impeached him and corrected his crime.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered him to investigate the case of Xia Shou'en. Inner attendant Cen Shouzhong used bribes to obstruct the law, and Ji impeached him and corrected his crime.

sentences.zh: 遷侍御史，夏守贇經略西鄙還，及言其無功，不可復樞府。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Attending Censor; when Xia Shouyun returned from pacifying the western frontier, Ji said he had achieved nothing and should not again enter the Military Affairs Commission.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Attending Censor. When Xia Shouyun returned from pacifying the western frontier, Ji said he had achieved nothing and should not again enter the Military Affairs Commission.

sentences.zh: 又疏罷郭承祐團練使。

translations.literal: He also submitted a memorial to dismiss Guo Chengyou as regimental trainer.
translations.idiomatic: He also submitted a memorial to dismiss Guo Chengyou as regimental trainer.

sentences.zh: 未幾，請知懷州，徙徐州，還為三司戶部判官，遷兵部員外郎、京東轉運按察使。

translations.literal: Before long he requested to serve as prefect of Huaizhou, was transferred to Xuzhou, returned to serve as Judge of the Households Bureau, and was promoted to Vice Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Transport Investigating Commissioner of Jingdong.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he requested to serve as prefect of Huaizhou, was transferred to Xuzhou, returned to serve as Judge of the Households Bureau, and was promoted to Vice Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Transport Investigating Commissioner of Jingdong.

sentences.zh: 知萊州張周物貪暴，及劾奏，貶周物嶺外。

translations.literal: The prefect of Laizhou, Zhang Zhouwu, was greedy and violent; Ji impeached and memorialized against him, and Zhouwu was demoted beyond the Lingnan passes.
translations.idiomatic: The prefect of Laizhou, Zhang Zhouwu, was greedy and violent. Ji impeached and memorialized against him, and Zhouwu was demoted beyond the Lingnan passes.

sentences.zh: 擢兼侍御史知雜事，數論時政，權判吏部流內銓。

translations.literal: He was promoted to concurrently serve as Chief Palace Censor, repeatedly discussed affairs of the age, and acted as judge of the Ministry of Personnel's Flowing Within Selection Office.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to concurrently serve as Chief Palace Censor, repeatedly discussed affairs of the age, and acted as judge of the Ministry of Personnel's Flowing Within Selection Office.

sentences.zh: 初，銓吏匿員闕，與選人為市，及奏闕至即榜之，吏部榜闕自及始。

translations.literal: At first selection clerks concealed vacant posts and made a market with candidates; Ji memorialized that whenever a vacancy arrived it should at once be posted, and the Ministry of Personnel's posting of vacancies began with Ji.
translations.idiomatic: At first selection clerks concealed vacant posts and made a market with candidates. Ji memorialized that whenever a vacancy arrived it should at once be posted, and the Ministry of Personnel's posting of vacancies began with Ji.

sentences.zh: 遷戶部副使，以疾，改刑部郎中、直昭文館、知衛州，召為鹽鐵副使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Vice Commissioner of the Households Bureau; because of illness he was changed to Director of the Department in the Ministry of Justice, Direct Attendant of the Hall for Spreading Culture, and prefect of Weizhou, and was summoned as Vice Commissioner of the Salt and Iron Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Vice Commissioner of the Households Bureau. Because of illness he was reassigned as Director of the Department in the Ministry of Justice, Direct Attendant of the Hall for Spreading Culture, and prefect of Weizhou, and was summoned as Vice Commissioner of the Salt and Iron Bureau.

sentences.zh: 又以疾，請知汝州，歲餘，復召為副使，不赴。

translations.literal: Again because of illness he requested to serve as prefect of Ruzhou; after more than a year he was again summoned as Vice Commissioner but did not go.
translations.idiomatic: Again because of illness he requested to serve as prefect of Ruzhou. After more than a year he was again summoned as Vice Commissioner but did not go.

sentences.zh: 徙知河中府，特拜天章閣待制、右司郎中。

translations.literal: He was transferred to serve as prefect of the Hezhong prefecture and was specially appointed Hanlin Attendant-in-Waiting and Director of the Right Department.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to serve as prefect of the Hezhong prefecture and was specially appointed Hanlin Attendant-in-Waiting and Director of the Right Department.

sentences.zh: 祀明堂，遷右諫議大夫。

translations.literal: At the Bright Hall sacrifice he was transferred to Right Remonstrance Officer.
translations.idiomatic: At the Bright Hall sacrifice he was transferred to Right Remonstrance Officer.

sentences.zh: 還判大理寺、流內銓。

translations.literal: He returned to judge the Grand Court of Justice and the Flowing Within Selection Office.
translations.idiomatic: He returned to judge the Grand Court of Justice and the Flowing Within Selection Office.

sentences.zh: 出知徐州，疾甚，求解近職，還州事，乃以本官管勾南京留司御史臺，未赴，卒。

translations.literal: He was sent out as prefect of Xuzhou; his illness was severe and he requested a nearby post; he returned to prefectural duties, and then with his original rank was put in charge of the Nanjing Remainder Censorate; before he went he died.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent out as prefect of Xuzhou. His illness was severe and he requested a nearby post. He returned to prefectural duties, and then with his original rank was put in charge of the Nanjing Remainder Censorate. Before he went he died.

sentences.zh: 及和厚謙退，內行尤篤，所治有聲，民吏愛之。

translations.literal: Ji was gentle, generous, and modest; his inner conduct was especially sincere; wherever he governed he gained a reputation, and officials and people loved him.
translations.idiomatic: Ji was gentle, generous, and modest, and his inner conduct was especially sincere. Wherever he governed he gained a reputation, and officials and people loved him.

sentences.zh: 劉湜，字子正，徐州彭城人。

translations.literal: Liu Shi, styled Zizheng, was a native of Pengcheng in Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Shi, whose style name was Zizheng, came from Pengcheng in Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 舉進士，為澶州觀察推官，再調湖南節度推官，改秘書省著作佐郎、知益都縣，徙陰平。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination, served as Investigating Push Officer of Danzhou, was transferred again to Push Officer of the Hunan Military Commission, was changed to Assistant Editor in the Secretariat and magistrate of Yidu County, and was transferred to Yingping.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination, served as Investigating Push Officer of Danzhou, was transferred again to Push Officer of the Hunan Military Commission, was reassigned as Assistant Editor in the Secretariat and magistrate of Yidu County, and was transferred to Yingping.

sentences.zh: 再遷太常博士、通判劍州。

translations.literal: After a further promotion he became Doctor of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Vice Prefect of Jian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: After a further promotion he became Doctor of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Vice Prefect of Jian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 審閬州獄，活死囚七人。

translations.literal: He reviewed the prisons of Langzhou and saved seven prisoners condemned to death.
translations.idiomatic: He reviewed the prisons of Langzhou and saved seven prisoners condemned to death.

sentences.zh: 王堯臣安撫陝西，薦之，擢知耀州。

translations.literal: Wang Yaochen, Military Commissioner of Shaanxi, recommended him, and he was promoted to prefect of Yaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yaochen, Military Commissioner of Shaanxi, recommended him, and he was promoted to prefect of Yaozhou.

sentences.zh: 富平有盜掠人子女者，既就擒，陽死，伺間逸去；

translations.literal: In Fuping there was a bandit who plundered people's children; once captured, he feigned death and waited for an opening to escape;
translations.idiomatic: In Fuping there was a bandit who plundered people's children. Once captured, he feigned death and waited for an opening to escape;

sentences.zh: 捕得，復陽死，守者以報，湜趣焚其屍。

translations.literal: When captured again he again feigned death; the guards reported it, and Shi hurried to burn the corpse.
translations.idiomatic: When captured again he again feigned death. The guards reported it, and Shi hurried to burn the corpse.

sentences.zh: 拜監察御史，王德用自隨州詔還，近臣言其有反相，湜保右之。

translations.literal: He was appointed Investigating Censor; when Wang Deyong was recalled by edict from Suizhou, close ministers said he had the physiognomy of rebellion, and Shi defended and protected him.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Investigating Censor. When Wang Deyong was recalled by edict from Suizhou, close ministers said he had the physiognomy of rebellion, and Shi defended and protected him.

sentences.zh: 曆開封府推官、三司鹽鐵判官，遷殿中侍御史。

translations.literal: He successively served as Investigating Officer of the Kaifeng Prefecture and Salt and Iron Judge, and was transferred to Attending Censor.
translations.idiomatic: He successively served as Investigating Officer of the Kaifeng Prefecture and Salt and Iron Judge, and was transferred to Attending Censor.

sentences.zh: 上言：「轉運使掎摭郡縣，苛束官吏，人不得騁其材，宜稍寬假，不為改者繩治之。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "Transport commissioners pick at faults in prefectures and counties and harshly bind officials; people cannot deploy their talents—there should be a little more latitude, and those who do not reform should be punished by law.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized, "Transport commissioners pick at faults in prefectures and counties and harshly bind officials. People cannot deploy their talents—there should be a little more latitude, and those who do not reform should be punished by law.

sentences.zh: 」詔詣渭州劾尹洙私用公使錢，頗傅致重法，以故洙坐廢。

translations.literal: An edict ordered him to go to Weizhou to investigate Yin Shu's private use of public envoy funds; he largely constructed a heavy penalty, and for this reason Shu was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered him to go to Weizhou to investigate Yin Shu's private use of public envoy funds. He largely constructed a heavy penalty, and for this reason Shu was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 還，為尚書禮部員外郎兼侍御史知雜事，同判吏部流內銓，除鹽鐵副使。

translations.literal: On his return he became Vice Director of the Rites Bureau in the Ministry of Revenue and concurrently Chief Palace Censor, jointly judged the Ministry of Personnel's Flowing Within Selection Office, and was appointed Vice Commissioner of the Salt and Iron Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he became Vice Director of the Rites Bureau in the Ministry of Revenue and concurrently Chief Palace Censor, jointly judged the Ministry of Personnel's Flowing Within Selection Office, and was appointed Vice Commissioner of the Salt and Iron Bureau.

sentences.zh: 議者謂湜探宰相意，深致洙罪，故得優擢焉。

translations.literal: Commentators said Shi had probed the chief councilor's intent and deeply brought about Shu's punishment, and therefore received preferential promotion.
translations.idiomatic: Commentators said Shi had probed the chief councilor's intent and deeply brought about Shu's punishment, and therefore received preferential promotion.

sentences.zh: 明年，宴紫宸殿，副使當坐殿東廡，湜不即坐，趣出。

translations.literal: The next year, at a banquet in the Hall of Purple Brightness, the Vice Commissioner should have sat in the eastern wing of the hall; Shi did not at once take his seat but hurried out.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, at a banquet in the Hall of Purple Brightness, the Vice Commissioner should have sat in the eastern wing of the hall. Shi did not at once take his seat but hurried out.

sentences.zh: 閣門奏之，坐謫知沂州，徙兗州。

translations.literal: The Gate Office reported it, and he was demoted to prefect of Yizhou and transferred to Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Gate Office reported it, and he was demoted to prefect of Yizhou and transferred to Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 又坐沂州誤出囚死罪，降知海州。

translations.literal: Again because at Yizhou he mistakenly released a prisoner condemned to death, he was demoted to prefect of Haizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Again because at Yizhou he mistakenly released a prisoner condemned to death, he was demoted to prefect of Haizhou.

sentences.zh: 起為河東轉運使，遷戶部員外郎，復為鹽鐵副使兼領河渠事。

translations.literal: He was raised up as Transport Commissioner of Hedong, was transferred to Vice Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and again became Vice Commissioner of the Salt and Iron Bureau while concurrently overseeing river works.
translations.idiomatic: He was raised up as Transport Commissioner of Hedong, was transferred to Vice Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and again became Vice Commissioner of the Salt and Iron Bureau while concurrently overseeing river works.

sentences.zh: 汴水絕，鑿河陰新渠，通漕運如故。

translations.literal: The Bian River dried up; he dug the new canal at Heyin and restored grain transport as before.
translations.idiomatic: The Bian River dried up. He dug the new canal at Heyin and restored grain transport as before.

sentences.zh: 會江南饑，擢天章閣待制、知江寧府，奏運蘇州米五十萬斛，以貸饑民。

translations.literal: It happened that Jiangnan suffered famine; he was promoted to Hanlin Attendant-in-Waiting and prefect of Jiangning Prefecture, and memorialized to transport five hundred thousand hu of rice from Suzhou to lend to the starving people.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that Jiangnan suffered famine. He was promoted to Hanlin Attendant-in-Waiting and prefect of Jiangning Prefecture, and memorialized to transport five hundred thousand hu of rice from Suzhou to lend to the starving people.

sentences.zh: 除戶部郎中、知廣州。

translations.literal: He was appointed Director of the Department in the Ministry of Revenue and prefect of Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Director of the Department in the Ministry of Revenue and prefect of Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 儂智高初平，湜練士兵，葺械器，作鐵鎖斷江路。

translations.literal: When Nong Zhigao had just been pacified, Shi drilled local soldiers, repaired weapons, and made iron chains to block the river route.
translations.idiomatic: When Nong Zhigao had just been pacified, Shi drilled local soldiers, repaired weapons, and made iron chains to block the river route.

sentences.zh: 有盜據山，敕貸罪招之，不肯降。

translations.literal: There was a bandit occupying a mountain; an edict pardoned his crime and summoned him, but he refused to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: There was a bandit occupying a mountain. An edict pardoned his crime and summoned him, but he refused to surrender.

sentences.zh: 湜知並山民資之食，即徙民絕餉，盜困蹙乞降，民安之。

translations.literal: Shi knew the people of the neighboring mountains supplied him with food; he at once moved the people and cut off supplies; the bandit, pressed hard, begged to surrender, and the people were at peace.
translations.idiomatic: Shi knew the people of the neighboring mountains supplied him with food. He at once moved the people and cut off supplies. The bandit, pressed hard, begged to surrender, and the people were at peace.

sentences.zh: 居二年，母老求內徙，遂徙徐州。

translations.literal: After two years his mother was old and he requested transfer inward; he was thereupon transferred to Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: After two years his mother was old and he requested transfer inward. He was thereupon transferred to Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 湜喜曰：「昔布衣隨計，今以侍從官三品復典鄉郡，過始望矣。

translations.literal: Shi said with joy: "Formerly as a commoner I followed the examination journey; now as a attendant-in-waiting of the third rank I again govern my home prefecture—I have exceeded my first hopes.
translations.idiomatic: Shi said with joy, "Formerly as a commoner I followed the examination journey. Now as an attendant-in-waiting of the third rank I again govern my home prefecture—I have exceeded my first hopes.

sentences.zh: 」又以左司郎中知鄆州，遷龍圖閣直學士、知慶州。

translations.literal: He was again made Director of the Left Department and prefect of Yan Prefecture, and was transferred to Direct Academician of the Dragon Diagram Hall and prefect of Qingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was again made Director of the Left Department and prefect of Yan Prefecture, and was transferred to Direct Academician of the Dragon Diagram Hall and prefect of Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 湜少賤，母更嫁營卒，既登第，具袍笏趨卒舍迎母，里人觀歎。

translations.literal: Shi was lowly in youth; his mother remarried a camp soldier; after he passed the examination he put on robe and tablet and hurried to the soldier's quarters to welcome his mother, and the people of the village watched and sighed.
translations.idiomatic: Shi was lowly in youth. His mother remarried a camp soldier. After he passed the examination he put on robe and tablet and hurried to the soldier's quarters to welcome his mother, and the people of the village watched and sighed.

sentences.zh: 然嗜酒，持法少恕，改知密州，以病卒。

translations.literal: Yet he was fond of wine, showed little leniency in enforcing the law, was changed to prefect of Mizhou, and died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he was fond of wine, showed little leniency in enforcing the law, was reassigned to prefect of Mizhou, and died of illness.

sentences.zh: 王彬，光州固始人。

translations.literal: Wang Bin was a native of Gushi in Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Bin was a native of Gushi in Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 祖彥英，父仁偘，從其族人潮入閩。

translations.literal: His grandfather Yan Ying and his father Ren Kan followed their clansman Chao into Min.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Yan Ying and his father Ren Kan followed their clansman Chao into Min.

sentences.zh: 潮有閩土，彥英頗用事，潮惡其逼，陰欲圖之。

translations.literal: Chao held Min territory; Yan Ying wielded considerable power; Chao hated his pressure and secretly plotted against him.
translations.idiomatic: Chao held Min territory. Yan Ying wielded considerable power. Chao hated his pressure and secretly plotted against him.

sentences.zh: 彥英覺之，挈家浮海奔新羅。

translations.literal: Yan Ying perceived this, took his family and fled by sea to Silla.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Ying perceived this, took his family, and fled by sea to Silla.

sentences.zh: 新羅長愛其材，用之，父子相繼執國政。

translations.literal: The ruler of Silla admired his talent and employed him; father and son successively held state power.
translations.idiomatic: The ruler of Silla admired his talent and employed him. Father and son successively held state power.

sentences.zh: 彬年十八，以賓貢入太學。

translations.literal: Bin at age eighteen entered the Imperial Academy as a tribute student.
translations.idiomatic: Bin at the age of eighteen entered the Imperial Academy as a tribute student.

sentences.zh: 淳化三年，進士及第，曆雍丘尉。

translations.literal: In the third year of Chunhua he passed the jinshi examination and successively served as Assistant Magistrate of Yongqiu.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Chunhua he passed the jinshi examination and successively served as Assistant Magistrate of Yongqiu.

sentences.zh: 皇城司陰遣人下畿縣刺史，多厲民，令佐至與為賓主。

translations.literal: The Imperial City Office secretly sent men down to the capital counties to investigate; they often oppressed the people, and magistrates and assistants even became host and guest with them.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial City Office secretly sent men down to the capital counties to investigate. They often oppressed the people, and magistrates and assistants even became host and guest with them.

sentences.zh: 彬至，捕鞫之，得所受賂，致之法，自是詔親事官毋得出都城。

translations.literal: When Bin arrived he arrested and interrogated them, obtained the bribes they had received, and punished them by law; from this an edict forbade personal-service officials from leaving the capital.
translations.idiomatic: When Bin arrived he arrested and interrogated them, obtained the bribes they had received, and punished them by law. From this an edict forbade personal-service officials from leaving the capital.

sentences.zh: 易右班殿直，辭不受。

translations.literal: He was changed to Right Guard Commander of the Rear and declined to accept.
translations.idiomatic: He was reassigned as Right Guard Commander of the Rear and declined to accept.

sentences.zh: 後以秘書省著作佐郎通判筠州，曆知撫州。

translations.literal: Later as Assistant Editor in the Secretariat he served as Vice Prefect of Junzhou and successively as prefect of Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Later as Assistant Editor in the Secretariat he served as Vice Prefect of Junzhou and successively as prefect of Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 撫州民李甲、饒英恃財武斷鄉曲，縣莫能製。

translations.literal: The people of Fuzhou, Li Jia and Rao Ying, relied on wealth to tyrannize the countryside by force; the county could not restrain them.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Fuzhou, Li Jia and Rao Ying, relied on wealth to tyrannize the countryside by force. The county could not restrain them.

sentences.zh: 甲從子詈縣令，人告甲語斥乘輿。

translations.literal: Jia's nephew cursed the county magistrate; someone reported that Jia's words insulted the imperial carriage.
translations.idiomatic: Jia's nephew cursed the county magistrate. Someone reported that Jia's words insulted the imperial carriage.

sentences.zh: 彬按治之，索其家得所藏兵械，又得服器有龍鳳飾，甲坐大逆棄市。

translations.literal: Bin investigated and punished them, searched Jia's house and obtained stored weapons, and also obtained garments and vessels with dragon and phoenix ornament; Jia was sentenced to great treason and executed in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: Bin investigated and punished them, searched Jia's house and obtained stored weapons, and also obtained garments and vessels with dragon and phoenix ornament. Jia was sentenced to great treason and executed in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 並按英嘗強取人孥，配嶺南，州裏肅然。

translations.literal: He also investigated Ying, who had forcibly taken people's wives and children, and assigned him to Lingnan; within the prefecture all was orderly.
translations.idiomatic: He also investigated Ying, who had forcibly taken people's wives and children, and assigned him to Lingnan. Within the prefecture all was orderly.

sentences.zh: 擢提點荊湖南路刑獄，徙知潭州，入判三司戶部勾院，出為京西轉運使，徙河北。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Judicial Intendant of Jinghu South Circuit, was transferred to prefect of Tanzhou, entered to judge the Three Departments' Households Audit Office, was sent out as Transport Commissioner of Jingxi, and was transferred to Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Judicial Intendant of Jinghu South Circuit, was transferred to prefect of Tanzhou, entered to judge the Three Departments' Households Audit Office, was sent out as Transport Commissioner of Jingxi, and was transferred to Hebei.

sentences.zh: 部吏馬崇正倚章獻太后姻家豪橫不法，彬發其奸贓，下吏。

translations.literal: A clerk of his department, Ma Chongzheng, relied on being a relative by marriage of Empress Dowager Zhangxian and was overbearing and lawless; Bin exposed his corruption and bribery and handed him to the officials.
translations.idiomatic: A clerk of his department, Ma Chongzheng, relied on being a relative by marriage of Empress Dowager Zhangxian and was overbearing and lawless. Bin exposed his corruption and bribery and handed him to the officials.

sentences.zh: 忤太后意，徙京東，又徙河東、陝西。

translations.literal: He offended the empress dowager's intent and was transferred to Jingdong, then again to Hedong and Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He offended the empress dowager's intent and was transferred to Jingdong, then again to Hedong and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 復為三司鹽鐵判官，判都理欠、憑由司，累遷太常少卿，卒。

translations.literal: He again became Salt and Iron Judge, judged the Arrears Settlement and Credential Offices, and after repeated promotions became Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and died.
translations.idiomatic: He again became Salt and Iron Judge, judged the Arrears Settlement and Credential Offices, and after repeated promotions became Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and died.

sentences.zh: 仲簡，字畏之，揚州江都人。

translations.literal: Zhong Jian, styled Weizhi, was a native of Jiangdu in Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong Jian, whose style name was Weizhi, came from Jiangdu in Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 以貧，傭書楊億門下，億教以詩賦，遂舉進士。

translations.literal: Because he was poor he copied books in Yang Yi's household; Yi taught him poetry and fu, and he thereupon passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: Because he was poor he copied books in Yang Yi's household. Yi taught him poetry and fu, and he thereupon passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 曆通判鄭州、河南府推官。

translations.literal: He successively served as Vice Prefect of Zheng Prefecture and Investigating Officer of Henan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He successively served as Vice Prefect of Zheng Prefecture and Investigating Officer of Henan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 改秘書省著作佐郎、知蕪湖縣，通判楚州，累遷尚書都官員外郎。

translations.literal: He was changed to Assistant Editor in the Secretariat and magistrate of Wuhu County, served as Vice Prefect of Chuzhou, and after repeated promotions became Vice Director of the Bureau of Public Works in the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He was reassigned as Assistant Editor in the Secretariat and magistrate of Wuhu County, served as Vice Prefect of Chuzhou, and after repeated promotions became Vice Director of the Bureau of Public Works in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 改侍御史、安撫京東，遷知真州，入為三司度支判官。

translations.literal: He was changed to Attending Censor and Military Commissioner of Jingdong, was transferred to prefect of Zhen Prefecture, and entered to serve as Judge of the Revenue Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: He was reassigned as Attending Censor and Military Commissioner of Jingdong, was transferred to prefect of Zhen Prefecture, and entered to serve as Judge of the Revenue Bureau.

sentences.zh: 經制陝西糧草，就遷兵部員外郎、直史館、知陝州。

translations.literal: He managed grain and fodder in Shaanxi and was thereupon transferred to Vice Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, Direct Historiographer, and prefect of Shaan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He managed grain and fodder in Shaanxi and was thereupon transferred to Vice Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, Direct Historiographer, and prefect of Shaan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 徙江東轉運使，除侍御史知雜事，為三司鹽鐵副使、工部郎中。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Transport Commissioner of Jiangdong, was appointed Chief Palace Censor, and served as Vice Commissioner of the Salt and Iron Bureau and Director of the Department in the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Transport Commissioner of Jiangdong, was appointed Chief Palace Censor, and served as Vice Commissioner of the Salt and Iron Bureau and Director of the Department in the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 奉使陝西，多任喜怒，以馬箠擊軍士流血，仁宗面詰之，不能對，出為河東轉運使。

translations.literal: On mission to Shaanxi he often indulged anger and joy, struck soldiers with a horse whip until they bled; Renzong questioned him to his face and he could not answer; he was sent out as Transport Commissioner of Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: On mission to Shaanxi he often indulged anger and joy and struck soldiers with a horse whip until they bled. Renzong questioned him to his face and he could not answer. He was sent out as Transport Commissioner of Hedong.

sentences.zh: 逾年，復為鹽鐵副使，再遷兵部，擢天章閣待制、知廣州。

translations.literal: After more than a year he again became Vice Commissioner of the Salt and Iron Bureau, was again transferred to the Bureau of Military Affairs, and was promoted to Hanlin Attendant-in-Waiting and prefect of Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a year he again became Vice Commissioner of the Salt and Iron Bureau, was again transferred to the Bureau of Military Affairs, and was promoted to Hanlin Attendant-in-Waiting and prefect of Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 儂智高犯邕州，沿江而下，人告急，簡輒囚之，仍榜於道，敢妄言惑眾者斬，以是人不復為避賊計。

translations.literal: When Nong Zhigao invaded Yongzhou and came down along the river, people reported emergencies; Jian at once imprisoned them and also posted notices along the road that whoever dared speak falsely to confuse the masses would be executed; because of this people no longer made plans to flee the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: When Nong Zhigao invaded Yongzhou and came down along the river, people reported emergencies. Jian at once imprisoned them and also posted notices along the road that whoever dared speak falsely to confuse the masses would be executed. Because of this people no longer made plans to flee the bandits.

sentences.zh: 比智高至，始令民入城，民爭道，競以金帛遺閽者，相蹂踐至死者甚多，其不得入者，皆附賊。

translations.literal: Only when Zhigao arrived did he at last order the people to enter the city; the people scrambled for the road, competing to give gold and silk to the gatekeepers; many were trampled to death; those who could not enter all joined the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Only when Zhigao arrived did he at last order the people to enter the city. The people scrambled for the road, competing to give gold and silk to the gatekeepers. Many were trampled to death, and those who could not enter all joined the bandits.

sentences.zh: 賊既去，以其能守城，徙知荊南。

translations.literal: After the bandits departed, because he was considered able to defend the city he was transferred to prefect of Jingnan.
translations.idiomatic: After the bandits departed, because he was considered able to defend the city he was transferred to prefect of Jingnan.

sentences.zh: 既而言者論之，遂落職，又降刑部郎中、知筠州。

translations.literal: Before long memorializers discussed him, and he was thereupon stripped of office; he was again demoted to Director of the Department in the Ministry of Justice and prefect of Jun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Before long memorializers discussed him, and he was thereupon stripped of office. He was again demoted to Director of the Department in the Ministry of Justice and prefect of Jun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 復為兵部郎中，徙洪州，卒。

translations.literal: He again became Director of the Department in the Ministry of Military Affairs, was transferred to Hongzhou, and died.
translations.idiomatic: He again became Director of the Department in the Ministry of Military Affairs, was transferred to Hongzhou, and died.

sentences.zh: 論曰：士抱一藝者，思奮勵以功名自效，況其設施見於政事者乎？

translations.literal: The commentator says: Scholars who hold a single art think to exert themselves and achieve merit and fame through their own efforts—how much more when their measures are seen in government affairs?
translations.idiomatic: The commentator says: Scholars who hold a single art think to exert themselves and achieve merit and fame through their own efforts—how much more when their measures are seen in government affairs?

sentences.zh: 方偕、曹穎叔、楊告、趙及、王彬之流皆文吏，能推恩行利，剗煩去蠹，其治不下古人。

translations.literal: Fang Xie, Cao Yingshu, Yang Gao, Zhao Ji, Wang Bin and their kind were all civil officials who could extend grace and carry out benefit, cut away burdens and remove corruption; their governance was not inferior to the ancients.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Xie, Cao Yingshu, Yang Gao, Zhao Ji, Wang Bin, and their kind were all civil officials who could extend grace and carry out benefit, cut away burdens, and remove corruption. Their governance was not inferior to the ancients.

sentences.zh: 劉元瑜、劉湜輩亦不減此數人，然而元瑜譏詆余靖，湜文致尹洙，公議所不與也。

translations.literal: Liu Yuanyu, Liu Shi and their kind were no less than these several men; yet Yuanyu slandered Yu Jing, and Shi constructed a case against Yin Shu—public opinion did not side with them.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yuanyu, Liu Shi, and their kind were no less than these several men. Yet Yuanyu slandered Yu Jing, and Shi constructed a case against Yin Shu—public opinion did not side with them.

sentences.zh: 仲簡小才，所謂斗筲之器也，何足道哉！

translations.literal: Zhong Jian had small talent—the so-called vessel of a peck measure; what is there worth speaking of!
translations.idiomatic: Zhong Jian had small talent—the so-called vessel of a peck measure. What is there worth speaking of!
